sentences.zh: 甲申，吐蕃論勃藏來朝貢。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Tibetan Lun Bozang came to court with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: A Tibetan envoy presented tribute on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, renchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month opened on renchen.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，葬順宗于豐陵。

translations.literal: On renyin Shunzong was buried at Feng Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: Shunzong was buried at Fengling on renyin.

sentences.zh: 己酉，太子少保致仕韓全義卒。

translations.literal: On jiyou retired Junior Tutor Han Quanyi died.
translations.idiomatic: Han Quanyi died in retirement on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, xinyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on xinyou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以左衛大將軍李願檢校禮部尚書、夏州刺史，充夏、綏、銀節度使。

translations.literal: On guihai Left Guard General Li Yuan was made acting Minister of Rites and prefect of Xia, commissioner of Xia, Sui, and Yin.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuan took the Xia-Sui command on guihai.

sentences.zh: 甲子，郇王母王昭儀、宋王母趙昭儀、郯王母張昭訓、衡王母閻昭訓等，各以其王並為太妃。

translations.literal: On jiazi the mothers of Princes of Xun, Song, Tan, and Heng — Ladies Wang Zhaoyi, Zhao Zhaoyi, Zhang Zhaoxun, and Yan Zhaoxun — were each made Grand Consort because of their princes.
translations.idiomatic: Four princes' mothers were ennobled as grand consorts on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 以許氏為美人，尹氏、段氏為才人。

translations.literal: Lady Xu was made Beauty; Ladies Yin and Duan were made Talents.
translations.idiomatic: Xu, Yin, and Duan received inner-palace ranks.

sentences.zh: 潯陽公主母崔昭訓為太妃。

translations.literal: Lady Cui Zhaoxun, mother of Princess Xunyang, was made Grand Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Xunyang's mother became grand consort.

sentences.zh: 韓全義子進女樂八人，詔還之。

translations.literal: Han Quanyi's son presented eight female musicians; an edict returned them.
translations.idiomatic: Han Quanyi's son offered women; the court refused them.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，封王子平原郡王甯為鄧王，同安郡王寬為澧王，建安郡王宥為遂王，彭城郡王察為深王，高密郡王寰為洋王，文安郡王寮為絳王，第十男審為建王。

translations.literal: On dingmao the princes — Prince of Pingyuan Ning as Prince of Deng, Tong'an Kuan as Prince of Li, Jian'an You as Prince of Sui, Pengcheng Cha as Prince of Shen, Gaomi Huan as Prince of Yang, Wen'an Liao as Prince of Jiang, and the tenth son Shen as Prince of Jian — were enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: Seven imperial sons received princely titles on dingmao.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以建王審為鄆州大都督、平盧淄青節度使；

translations.literal: On jisi Prince of Jian Shen was made Grand Protector of Yan and Pinglu-Ziqing military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Young Prince Shen was named nominal Yan commander while

sentences.zh: 以節度副使李師道權知鄆州事，充節度留後。

translations.literal: Vice Commissioner Li Shidao was provisionally made to handle Yan affairs and act as regent.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shidao held real power as regent at Yan.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，冊妃郭氏為貴妃。

translations.literal: On yihai Consort Guo was enfeoffed Honored Consort.
translations.idiomatic: Lady Guo became honored consort on yihai.

sentences.zh: 靈武李欒奏，黃河岸塌處得古錢三千三百，其形小，方孔，三足。

translations.literal: Li Luan of Lingwu memorialized: at a Yellow River bank collapse ancient coins were obtained, 3,300 in number — their form small, square hole, three feet.
translations.idiomatic: Lingwu reported ancient coins found in a Yellow River collapse.

sentences.zh: 壬午，左降官韋執誼，韓泰、陳諫、柳宗元、劉禹錫、韓曄、淩准、程異等八人，縱逢恩赦，不在量移之限癸未。

translations.literal: On renwu the eight demoted officials Wei Zhiyi, Han Tai, Chen Jian, Liu Zongyuan, Liu Yuxi, Han Ye, Ling Zhun, and Cheng Yi — even if they met amnesty edicts — were not within the limit of transferred exile.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu eight Shuwen partisans were barred forever from amnesty relocation.

sentences.zh: ，京兆尹董叔經卒。

translations.literal: On guiwei Metropolitan Governor Dong Shujing died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei capital intendant Dong Shujing died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，御史台奏，常參官在城未上及在外未到、假故等，在外未到，計水陸程外，滿百日，並停解，從之。

translations.literal: On jiashen the Censorate memorialized: regular-attendance officials in the capital who did not attend, and those outside who had not arrived, leave and excuses — for those outside not arrived, beyond water and land journey time, full one hundred days — all were to be suspended and dismissed; it was followed.
translations.idiomatic: Absentee officials were to be dismissed after a hundred days on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以尚書右丞李鄘為京兆尹。

translations.literal: On bingxu Right Vice Director Li Yong was made Metropolitan Governor.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yong returned to the capital magistracy on bingxu.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯朔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, xinmao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on xinmao.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，詔自今後兩省官每坐日一人對。

translations.literal: On guimao an edict: from now on one official of the two departments each court day shall face the throne.
translations.idiomatic: A Secretariat-Chancellery rotation for daily audiences was ordered on guimao.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以太子賓客鄭余慶為國子祭酒。

translations.literal: On bingwu Junior Mentor to the Heir Zheng Yuqing was made Chancellor of the National University.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yuqing became university chancellor on bingwu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，高崇文奏收成都，擒劉辟以獻。

translations.literal: On xinhai Gao Chongwen memorialized recovery of Chengdu; Liu Pi was captured and presented.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Chongwen took Chengdu and sent Liu Pi captive on xinhai.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以山人李渤為左拾遺，征不至。

translations.literal: On guichou the mountain man Li Bo was made Left Reminder — summoned, he did not come.
translations.idiomatic: Li Bo was appointed but refused office on guichou.

sentences.zh: 甲子，易定張茂昭來朝。

translations.literal: On jiazi Yiding Zhang Maozhao came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Maozhao visited court on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以劍南東川節度使、檢校兵部尚書、梓州刺史、封渤海郡王高崇文檢校司空，兼成都尹、御史大夫，充劍南西川節度副大使、知節度事、管內度支營田觀察使、處置統押近界諸蠻及西山八國雲南安撫等使，仍改封南平郡王，食邑三千戶。

translations.literal: On bingyin Gao Chongwen, eastern Sichuan military commissioner, acting Minister of War, prefect of Zi, enfeoffed Prince of Bohai, was made acting Master of Works, concurrent Governor of Chengdu, Censor-in-Chief, Sichuan vice military commissioner and acting commissioner, revenue and garrison observer, commissioner to manage nearby tribes and the eight western nations' Yunnan pacification, and other duties; he was also changed to Prince of Nanping with a fief of three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Chongwen received sweeping western honors on bingyin.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以山南西道節度使嚴礪為梓州刺史、劍南東川節度使；

translations.literal: On wuxu southwestern Shannan military commissioner Yan Li was made prefect of Zi and eastern Sichuan military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Yan Li and Liu Zhan exchanged Sichuan posts on wuxu;

sentences.zh: 以將作監柳晟檢校工部尚書，兼興元尹，充山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: Director of Palace Construction Liu Sheng was made acting Minister of Works and concurrent Governor of Xingyuan, southwestern Shannan military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Sheng took Xingyuan and southwestern Shannan.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以吉州刺史袁滋為御史大夫，充義成軍節度使。

translations.literal: On gengchen Yuan Zi, prefect of Ji, was made Censor-in-Chief and Yicheng army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zi left exile for the Yicheng command on gengchen.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以淄青節度使留後李師道檢校工部尚書，兼鄆卅大都督府長史，充平盧淄青節度副大使、知節度事。

translations.literal: On renwu Li Shidao, regent of the Ziqing military commission, was made acting Minister of Works, Grand Protector of Yan prefecture, and vice military commissioner of Pinglu-Ziqing.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shidao received formal Ziqing command on renwu.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以渤海國王大嵩璘檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On bingxu King Daesung of Parhae was made acting Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: The Parhae king was honored on bingxu.

sentences.zh: 戊子，斬劉辟並子超郎等九人於獨柳樹下。

translations.literal: On wuzi Liu Pi and his son Chao Lang and nine others were executed beneath the Lone Willow tree.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Pi and nine kin were executed on wuzi.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚寅朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, gengyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on gengyin.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以簡王傅王權為河南尹。

translations.literal: On jisi Wang Quan, tutor of the Prince of Jian, was made Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Quan became Henan governor on jisi.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以司農卿李上公為陝州大都督府長史，充陝虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On dingwei Li Shanggong, Minister of Imperial Farms, was made Grand Protector of Shaan and Shaan-Guo observer.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shanggong took the Shaan circuit on dingwei.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以武寧軍節度張愔為工部尚書，以東都留守王紹檢校右僕射，兼徐州刺史、武甯軍節度使、徐泗濠等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: On jiashen Zhang Yin, Wuning military commissioner, was made Minister of Works; eastern capital regent Wang Shao was made acting Right Vice Director, concurrent prefect of Xu and Wuning military commissioner and Xu-Si-Hao observer.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yin and Wang Shao changed Xu posts on jiashen.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以吏部侍郎趙宗儒為東都留守、東畿汝防禦使，以國子祭酒鄭餘慶為河南尹。

translations.literal: On gengxu Vice Minister of Personnel Zhao Zongru was made eastern capital regent and eastern Ji-Ru defender; Chancellor of the National University Zheng Yuqing was made Governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zongru and Zheng Yuqing took eastern capital posts on gengxu.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以給事中劉宗經為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: On jiayin Supervisor of Attendants Liu Zongjing was made prefect of Hua, Tongguan defender, and Zhenguo army commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Zongjing took Hua-Zhenguo on jiayin.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以內常侍吐突承璀為神策護軍中尉。

translations.literal: On bingchen Inner Regular Attendant Tutu Chengcui was made lieutenant protector of the Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Tutu Chengcui became Shence commander on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申朔，太常奏隱太子、章懷、懿德、節湣、惠莊、惠文、惠宣、請恭、昭靖以下九太子陵，代數已遠，官額空存，今請陵戶外並停。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, bingshen new moon — the Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: the hidden heir and Zhang Huai, Yide, Jiemin, Huizhuang, Huiwen, Huixuan, Qinggong, and Zhaojing — the nine princes' mausoleums below — generations are already distant, official quotas empty — now request that outside the mausoleum households all cease.
translations.idiomatic: Nine remote princes' tomb households were abolished on bingshen.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，工部尚書張愔卒。

translations.literal: On yihai Minister of Works Zhang Yin died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yin died on yihai.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，新羅、渤海、牂柯、回紇各遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On bingxu Silla, Parhae, Zangke, and Uighur each sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Four frontier states sent tribute on bingxu.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月己丑朔，上親獻太清宮、太廟。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, jichou new moon — the Emperor personally offered at the Supreme Clear Palace and Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanhe 2 he personally sacrificed at the ancestral shrines.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，祀昊天上帝於郊丘，是日還宮，禦丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On xinmao he sacrificed to August Heaven at the suburban mound; that day he returned to the palace, took Danfeng Tower, and proclaimed a great amnesty for the empire.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao he performed the suburban rite and proclaimed amnesty.

sentences.zh: 先是，將及大禮，陰晦浹辰，宰臣請改日，上曰：「郊廟事重，齋戒有日，不可遽更。

translations.literal: Earlier, as the great rites approached, overcast gloom lasted ten days; the councillors asked to change the day; the Emperor said: "Suburban and temple affairs are weighty; fasting has its days — they cannot hastily be altered."
translations.idiomatic: He refused to postpone the rite despite ten days of rain.

sentences.zh: 」享獻之辰，景物晴霽，人情欣悅。

translations.literal: On the day of offering the scenery cleared — people's hearts were glad.
translations.idiomatic: The sky cleared for the sacrifice, to popular joy.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，司徒杜祐辭知政事。

translations.literal: On dingyou Minister of Education Du You declined handling administration.
translations.idiomatic: Du You resigned the council on dingyou.

sentences.zh: 詔令每月三度入朝，便於中書商量政事。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him three times a month to enter court; he was then to discuss administration at the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was kept as a thrice-monthly consultant at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 庚子，回紇請于河南府、太原府置摩尼寺，許之。

translations.literal: On gengzi the Uighurs requested to place Manichaean temples in Henan and Taiyuan prefectures — it was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Uighur Manichaean temples were allowed in Henan and Taiyuan on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以門下侍郎、同平章事、南陽郡開國公杜黃裳檢校司空、同平章事，兼河中尹、河中晉絳等州節度使。

translations.literal: On yisi Du Huangchang, Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, and Duke of Nanyang, was made acting Master of Works and Grand Councillor, concurrent Governor of Hezhong and Hezhong-Jin-Jiang military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Du Huangchang went west to Hezhong on yisi.

sentences.zh: 停諸陵留守。

translations.literal: All mausoleum regents were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Mausoleum regents were abolished.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以戶部侍郎、賜緋魚袋武元衡為門下侍郎、同平章事、賜紫金魚袋，以中書舍人、翰林學士李吉甫為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On jimao Wu Yuanheng, Vice Minister of Revenue and bearer of the crimson fish bag, was made Vice Director of the Chancellery, Grand Councillor, and bearer of the purple-gold fish bag; Secretariat Drafter and Hanlin academician Li Jifu was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Grand Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuanheng and Li Jifu entered the council on jimao.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，停中和、重陽二節賜宴；

translations.literal: On dingsi the Zhonghe and Chongyang festival banquets were stopped;
translations.idiomatic: Mid-autumn and Double Ninth court banquets were cut on dingsi;

sentences.zh: 其上巳宴，仍舊賜之。

translations.literal: the Upper Si banquet was still bestowed as before.
translations.idiomatic: but the Upper Si feast remained.

sentences.zh: 二月辛酉，詔僧尼道士全隸左右街功德使，自是祠部司封不復關奏。

translations.literal: Second month, xinyou — an edict: Buddhist and Daoist monks and nuns were entirely placed under the left and right street merit commissioners; from this the Ministries of Rites and Revenue no longer handled memorials.
translations.idiomatic: Clergy were placed under palace eunuch commissioners in the second month.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，左右羽林軍應管月飜騎總五千六百一十三人，並停。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Left and Right Forest Guards' monthly drill cavalry, 5,613 in all, were all stopped.
translations.idiomatic: 5,613 ceremonial cavalry were disbanded on bingyin.

sentences.zh: 己巳，起居舍人鄭隨次對，面受進止；

translations.literal: On jisi Diary Attendant Zheng Sui had sequential audience and received orders face to face;
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the emperor ended sequential audience for attendants

sentences.zh: 令宣與兩省供奉官，自今已後，有事即進狀，次對官宜停。

translations.literal: an order proclaimed to both departments' service officials — from now when there is business, immediately submit a memorial; the sequential audience officer should stop.
translations.idiomatic: and required memorials instead of oral queue audiences.

sentences.zh: 庚午，司天造新曆成，詔題為《元和觀象曆》。

translations.literal: On gengwu the Directorate of Astronomy completed a new calendar; an edict titled it "Yuanhe Observing the Phenomena Calendar."
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanhe calendar was promulgated on gengwu.

sentences.zh: 壬申夜，月掩歲星。

translations.literal: On renshen night the moon covered the Year Star.
translations.idiomatic: The moon occulted Jupiter on renshen night.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，寒食節，宴群臣於麟德殿，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On dingchou, Cold Food festival, the ministers were feasted at Linde Hall; gifts were graded.
translations.idiomatic: Cold Food brought a graded feast at Linde on dingchou.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以第五國軫為右神策軍中尉。

translations.literal: On renwu Di Guozhen was made lieutenant protector of the Right Divine Strategy Army.
translations.idiomatic: Di Guozhen joined the Shence command on renwu.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，賜群臣宴於曲江亭。

translations.literal: Third month, xinmao — the ministers were feasted at Qujiang Pavilion.
translations.idiomatic: The court feasted at Qujiang in the third month.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，判度支李巽為兵部尚書，依前判度支鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: On guimao Li Xun, acting revenue commissioner, was made Minister of War while still acting revenue, salt, and transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Xun kept fiscal power while gaining the war ministry on guimao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲子，禁鉛錫錢。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jiazi — lead-tin coin was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Lead and tin cash were banned in the fourth month.

sentences.zh: 以右金吾衛大將軍范希朝為檢校司空、靈州長史、朔方靈鹽節度使。

translations.literal: Fan Xichao, Grand General of the Right Golden Guard, was made acting Master of Works, Governor of Ling, and Shuofang-Ling-Salt military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Xichao went north to Lingzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，近置英武軍額，宜停。

translations.literal: On wuyin the recently established Heroic Martial army designation was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The Yingwu army title was abolished on wuyin.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，嶺南節度使趙昌進瓊、管、儋、振、萬安六州《六十二洞歸降圖》。

translations.literal: On gengchen Lingnan military commissioner Zhao Chang presented a map of sixty-two cave-districts of Qiong, Guan, Dan, Zhen, and Wan'an submitting.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Chang presented a map of Lingnan tribes submitting on gengchen.

sentences.zh: 六月丁巳朔，始置百官待漏院於建福門外。

translations.literal: Sixth month, dingsi new moon — the hundred officials' awaiting-leak court was first established outside Jianfu Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The waiting court outside Jianfu was established in the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 故事，建福、望仙等門，昏而閉，五更而啟，與諸坊門同時。

translations.literal: By precedent, Jianfu and Wangxian gates closed at dusk and opened at fifth watch, together with ward gates.
translations.idiomatic: Capital gates had once closed at dusk like ward gates.

sentences.zh: 至德中有吐蕃囚自金吾仗亡命，因敕晚開門，宰相待漏于太僕寺車坊。

translations.literal: In the Zhide era Tibetan prisoners escaped from the Golden Guard; therefore an order delayed opening the gate; councillors awaited the leak at the Imperial Stud chariot yard.
translations.idiomatic: A Tibetan escape had led councillors to wait in a chariot yard after late opening.

sentences.zh: 至是始令有司據班品置院。

translations.literal: Now the relevant offices were ordered according to rank to establish the court.
translations.idiomatic: Now a proper waiting hall was built by rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，鳳翔節度使張敬則卒。

translations.literal: On wuwu Fengxiang military commissioner Zhang Jingze died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Jingze of Fengxiang died on wuwu.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，五坊色役戶及中書門下兩省納課陪廚戶及捉錢人，並歸府縣色役。

translations.literal: On yichou colored-service households of the five wards and tax-paying kitchen households of the two departments and tax-collectors were all returned to prefecture and county corvée service.
translations.idiomatic: Palace craft and kitchen households reverted to local corvée on yichou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，停舒、廬、滁、和四州團練使額。

translations.literal: On jisi the Shu, Lu, Chu, and He four prefectures' regimental commissioner titles were stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Four prefectural regiment titles were abolished on jisi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，東都莊宅使織造戶，並委府縣收管，乙亥，停潤州丹陽軍額。

translations.literal: On guiyou eastern capital manor-weaving households were all entrusted to prefecture and county control; on yihai Runzhou Danyang army designation was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern capital weaving households and the Danyang army title ended.

sentences.zh: 丙子，左神策軍新築夾城，置玄化門晨耀樓。

translations.literal: On bingzi the Left Divine Strategy Army newly built the flanking wall, establishing the Xuanshe Gate and Chenyao Tower.
translations.idiomatic: The Shence army expanded its walled compound on bingzi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以京兆尹李鄘為鳳翔尹、鳳翔隴右節度使。

translations.literal: On xinsi Li Yong, Metropolitan Governor, was made Governor of Fengxiang and Fengxiang-Longyou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yong left the capital for Fengxiang on xinsi.

sentences.zh: 蔡州水，平地深七八尺。

translations.literal: Cai prefecture flooded — eight or seven feet deep on level ground.
translations.idiomatic: Caizhou was inundated to a depth of seven or eight feet.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌朔，敕刑部侍郎許孟容等刪定《開元格後敕》。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, bingxu new moon — an order: Vice Minister of Justice Xu Mengrong and others were to revise and fix the Kaiyuan Code and later edicts.
translations.idiomatic: The seventh month ordered revision of Tang law codes.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，敕外命婦朝謁皇太后，多有前卻，今後諸親委宗正寺，百官母妻委台司，如有違越者，夫子在一月俸，頻不到，有司具狀奏聞。

translations.literal: On dinghai an order: outer appointed women attending the empress dowager — many advanced or retreated improperly; hereafter consorts were entrusted to the Imperial Clan Court, officials' mothers and wives to the Censorate — if there were violations, the husband's one-month salary; frequent failure to attend — the relevant office was to memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: Women's audiences at the dowager's court were regulated on dinghai.

sentences.zh: 戊子，錄配享功臣之後，得蘇瑰孫系，用為京兆府司錄；

translations.literal: On wuzi descendants of meritorious ministers who shared temple sacrifice were recorded — Su Gui's grandson Ji was used as Metropolitan Records Officer;
translations.idiomatic: Descendants of famous ministers were appointed on wuzi:

sentences.zh: 崔玄暐孫元方、張說孫騑，並為監察御史；

translations.literal: Cui Xuanwei's grandson Yuanfang and Zhang Yue's grandson Pian were all made investigating censors;
translations.idiomatic: Su Gui's and Zhang Yue's descendants among them;

sentences.zh: 狄仁傑後玄範，為右拾遺；

translations.literal: Di Renjie's descendant Xuanfan was made Right Reminder;
translations.idiomatic: Di Renjie's heir became remonstrator;

sentences.zh: 敬暉孫元亮、袁恕己孫德師，相次敘用。

translations.literal: Jing Hui's descendant Yuanliang and Yuan Shuji's descendant Deshi were appointed in succession.
translations.idiomatic: and others of Jing Hui and Yuan Shuji's lines.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，太僕寺丞令狐丕進亡父峘所撰《代宗實錄》四十卷，詔贈峘工部尚書。

translations.literal: On guisi Palace Studs Assistant Director Linghu Pi presented the lost father's Linghu Huan's compiled Veritable Records of Daizong in forty rolls; an edict posthumously made Huan Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Linghu Huan's Daizong annals were accepted and he was posthumously honored on guisi.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, bingchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on bingchen.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，宰相武元衡兼判戶部事。

translations.literal: On xinyou Grand Councillor Wu Yuanheng was additionally made acting revenue commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Yuanheng took the revenue commission on xinyou.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，刑部奏改《律》卷第八普《鬥競律》。

translations.literal: On renxu the Ministry of Justice memorialized changing Code scroll 8 from general Brawling Law.
translations.idiomatic: The brawling statute was revised on renxu.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以職方員外郎王潔為嶺南選補使，監察御史崔元方監之。

translations.literal: On jiazi Wang Jie, outer bureau director in the Ministry of Personnel, was made Lingnan selection and supplement commissioner; investigating censor Cui Yuanfang supervised.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Jie was sent to staff Lingnan appointments on jiazi.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，中書奏：「先停諸道奏祥瑞。

translations.literal: On jiaxu the Secretariat memorialized: "Formerly stopping all circuits' memorializing auspicious omens.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu the council revised omen policy:

sentences.zh: 伏以所獻祥瑞，皆緣臘饗、告廟、元會奏聞，今後諸大瑞隨表聞奏，中瑞、下瑞申有司，其元日奏祥瑞，請依令式。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that auspicious omens presented are all because of year-end feasts, temple announcements, and New Year audiences reporting — hereafter great omens follow the memorial and report, middle and lower omens are declared to the relevant offices; the New Year's auspicious memorial — request following the statute form.
translations.idiomatic: great omens would still reach the throne on feast days; lesser ones stayed with local offices.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: "It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The throne agreed.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，封杜黃裳為邠國公，于頔為燕國公。

translations.literal: On xinsi Du Huangxiang was enfeoffed Duke of Bin and Yu Di Duke of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Du Huangxiang became Duke of Bin and Yu Di Duke of Yan.

sentences.zh: 沒蕃僧惟良闡等四百五十人自蕃中還。

translations.literal: More than four hundred fifty monks including Weiliangchan who had been lost in Tibet returned.
translations.idiomatic: Over four hundred monks lost to Tibet, led by Weiliangchan, came home.

sentences.zh: 九月乙酉，密王綢薨。

translations.literal: Ninth month, yiyou: Prince Mi Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yiyou, Prince Mi Chong died.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉，以浙西節度使李錡為左僕射；

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiyou: Zhexi circuit commissioner Li Qi was made Left Vice Director;
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, jiyou: Li Qi of Zhexi became Left Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 以御史大夫李元素為潤州刺史，鎮海軍、浙西節度使。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Li Yuansu was made Run prefect, Zhenhai army and Zhexi circuit commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuansu took Runzhou and the Zhenhai–Zhexi command.

sentences.zh: 庚申，李錡據潤州反，殺判官王澹、大將趙琦。

translations.literal: On gengshen Li Qi seized Runzhou in rebellion and killed judge Wang Dan and great general Zhao Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Qi rebelled at Runzhou, killing Wang Dan and Zhao Qi.

sentences.zh: 時錡詐請入朝，署澹為留後，因諷詔：「李錡屬列宗枝，任居方伯，赫奕之跺，飽綢繆之恩。

translations.literal: At the time Qi had falsely requested to enter court; he had appointed Dan acting commissioner, then prompted an edict: "Li Qi belongs to the imperial clan branch, holds a frontier post, his splendor and favor have been full of cordial grace.
translations.idiomatic: Qi had feigned a court visit and left Dan in charge, then procured an edict denouncing his clan rank and ingratitude.

sentences.zh: 待以親賢，報之以逆節；

translations.literal: Treated as kin and worthy, he answered with treason;
translations.idiomatic: Honored as kin, he answered with treason;

sentences.zh: 授其師旅，用元以亂常。

translations.literal: given armies, he used troops to disturb order.
translations.idiomatic: given troops, he turned them to disorder.

sentences.zh: 屢獻表章，亟請朝會，初則詐疾，後萬縱兵。

translations.literal: Again and again he submitted memorials, urgently asking for court audience — first feigning illness, later openly raising troops.
translations.idiomatic: He piled up memorials begging audience, first shamming sickness, then openly mustering troops.

sentences.zh: 僚佐以獻規受屠，王臣以傳命見脅。

translations.literal: Staff who offered counsel were slaughtered; court envoys who bore decrees were coerced.
translations.idiomatic: Advisers were killed; imperial messengers were held hostage.

sentences.zh: 朕切於含垢，未忍發明，累降中人，令遵前旨。

translations.literal: The Emperor, urgent to swallow disgrace, had not yet wished to expose him, repeatedly sending inner attendants to order compliance with prior intent.
translations.idiomatic: The throne had long swallowed insult, sending eunuchs again and again before breaking silence.

sentences.zh: 無軺車之戒路，有沴氣之滔天。

translations.literal: There was no warning of the carriage's road; baleful vapors filled the sky.
translations.idiomatic: No loyal escort came; rebellion's miasma filled the sky.

sentences.zh: 加以日逞淫刑，月興暴賦。

translations.literal: Moreover day by day he practiced cruel punishments and month by month raised violent levies.
translations.idiomatic: Daily tortures and monthly extortions followed.

sentences.zh: 朕為人父母，聞甚惻然，顧惟紀綱，焉敢廢墜！

translations.literal: As father and mother to the people, hearing this the Emperor was deeply moved; looking to discipline, how dare he let it fall!
translations.idiomatic: As parent of the realm he grieved — yet discipline could not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 李錡在身官爵，並宜削奪。

translations.literal: Li Qi's personal offices and titles are all to be stripped.
translations.idiomatic: All of Li Qi's ranks were stripped.

sentences.zh: 」以淮南節度使王鍔充諸道行營招討使，內官薛尚衍為監軍，率汴、徐、鄂、淮南、宣歙之師，取宣州路進討。

translations.literal: " Huainan commissioner Wang E was made overall campaign commander of all circuits; inner attendant Xue Shangyan was made army supervisor, leading Bian, Xu, E, Huainan, and Xuan-She forces by the Xuanzhou route to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E of Huainan led a multi-circuit campaign with eunuch Xue Shangyan as supervisor.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以門下侍郎、平章事武元衡檢校吏部尚書、兼門下侍郎、平章事、成都尹、充劍南西川節度使，仍封臨淮郡公。

translations.literal: On dingmao Vice Director and Grand Councilor Wu Yuanheng was made acting War Minister, concurrent Vice Director, Grand Councilor, Chengdu Intendant, and Jiannan West circuit commissioner, still enfeoffed Duke of Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Wu Yuanheng went west as Linhuai duke and Jiannan commissioner.

sentences.zh: 將行，上御安福門慰勞之。

translations.literal: As he was to depart, the Emperor came to Anfu Gate to console and send him off.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor saw him off at Anfu Gate.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，潤州大將張子閬、李奉獨等執李錡以獻。

translations.literal: On guiyou Runzhou great generals Zhang Zilang, Li Fengdu, and others seized Li Qi and presented him captive.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Runzhou generals seized Qi and sent him captive.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，錡從父弟宋州刺史銛、通事舍人銑坐貶嶺外。

translations.literal: On xinsi Qi's paternal cousin Song prefect Qian and Herald Qian were both demoted beyond the ranges.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Qi's cousins Qian and Qian were exiled to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，斬李錡於獨柳樹下，削錡屬籍。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiashen: Li Qi was beheaded beneath the Lone Willow; Qi's clan register was expunged.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiashen: Qi was beheaded at Lone Willow and struck from the clan rolls.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以擒李錡潤州牙將張子良為左金吾衛將軍，封南陽郡王；

translations.literal: On bingxu Zhang Ziliang, Runzhou yamen general who captured Qi, was made Left Golden Guards general and enfeoffed Prince of Nanyang;
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Zhang Ziliang, who took Qi, became a Golden Guards general and Prince of Nanyang;

sentences.zh: 田少卿、李奉仙等為羽林將軍，並封公。

translations.literal: Tian Shaoqing, Li Fengxian, and others were made Feathered Forest generals, all enfeoffed dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Shaoqing and Li Fengxian were made Feathered Forest generals and enfeoffed dukes.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔司徒杜祐筋力未衰，起今後每日入中書視事。

translations.literal: On jiachen an edict: Grand Mentor Du You's strength is not yet spent — henceforth he shall enter the Secretariat daily to handle affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Du You was ordered to attend the Secretariat daily.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，宰相李吉甫封贊皇侯。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiayin: Chancellor Li Jifu was enfeoffed Marquis of Zanhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiayin: Li Jifu became Marquis of Zanhuang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，上謂宰臣曰：「朕覽國書，見文皇帝行事，少有過差，諫臣論諍，往復數四。

translations.literal: On bingchen the Emperor told the chancellors: "Reading the national records, I see that in Emperor Wen's conduct there were few faults; remonstrating officials debated back and forth three or four times.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he told his chancellors that Taizong welcomed repeated remonstrance — and he wanted the same.

sentences.zh: 況朕之寡昧，涉道未明，今後事或未當，卿等每事十論，不可一二而止。

translations.literal: How much more am I, of scant wisdom, not yet clear on the Way — hereafter if anything is not right, you must debate each matter ten times; you may not stop at one or two.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that every doubtful policy be argued ten times over, not once or twice.

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，東都國子監增置學生一百人。

translations.literal: On dingsi the Eastern Capital Directorate of Education added one hundred students.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Luoyang's Directorate added one hundred students.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，御史台奏：「文武常參官准乾元元年三月十四日敕，如有朝堂相吊慰及跪拜、待漏行立失序，語笑喧嘩；

translations.literal: On guihai the Censorate memorialized: "For civil and military regular attendees, per the Zhenyuan 1 third-month fourteenth-day edict, if at court they console one another, kneel, or while awaiting the leak stand out of order, jest and clamor;
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Censorate proposed fines for disorderly conduct at court under the Zhenyuan rules:

sentences.zh: 入衙入閣，執笏不端，行立遲慢；

translations.literal: entering the yamen or entering the pavilion, holding the tablet not upright, walking or standing slowly;
translations.idiomatic: improper tablets, slow movement in the yamen;

sentences.zh: 立班不正，趨拜失儀，言語微喧嘩穿班穿仗，出入閣門，無故離位；

translations.literal: standing in ranks not straight, hurrying and bowing with lost ritual, speech slightly clamorous, cutting through ranks or through the guard formation, leaving the gate without cause;
translations.idiomatic: crooked ranks, loud speech, cutting through guards, leaving post without cause;

sentences.zh: 廊下飲食，行坐失儀喧鬧；

translations.literal: eating and drinking in the corridor, sitting or standing with lost ritual and clamor;
translations.idiomatic: corridor feasting and rowdy sitting;

sentences.zh: 入朝及退朝不從正衙出入；

translations.literal: entering or leaving court not by the main hall route;
translations.idiomatic: entering or leaving court by side doors;

sentences.zh: 非公事入中書等：每犯奪一月俸。

translations.literal: entering the Secretariat without public business: each offense deducts one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: unauthorized entry to the Secretariat: one month's salary lost per offense.

sentences.zh: 班列不肅，所由指摘，猶或飾非，即具聞奏貶責。

translations.literal: If ranks are not solemn and the officer pointed out still ornaments wrong, report and memorialize for demotion and censure.
translations.idiomatic: Persistent offenders were to be reported for demotion.

sentences.zh: 臣等商量，於舊條每罰各減一半，所貴有犯必舉。

translations.literal: Your subjects have considered halving each penalty under the old articles, so that if there is an offense it will surely be reported.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to halve the old penalties so violations would surely be cited.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以劍南西川節度使高崇文檢校司空、同平章事，兼邠州刺史、邠甯慶節度使，充京西諸軍都統。

translations.literal: On bingyin Jiannan West commissioner Gao Chongwen was made acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, concurrent Bin prefect and Bin-Ning-Qing commissioner, and commander-in-chief of all Jingxi armies.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Gao Chongwen took Binning and command of Jingxi armies.

sentences.zh: 壬申，禮部舉人，罷試口義，試墨義十條，五經通五，明經通六，即放進士。

translations.literal: On renshen Rites Department candidates: oral examination was abolished; ten written meaning questions — passing five classics for jinshi, six for mingjing — then jinshi was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen the civil exam dropped oral tests for written classics thresholds.

sentences.zh: 舉人曾為官司科罰，曾任州縣小吏，雖有辭藝，長吏不得舉送，違者舉送官停任，考試官貶黜。

translations.literal: Candidates once punished by government offices or once county clerks, though possessing literary skill, may not be nominated by senior officials — violators' nominators are suspended from office and examiners demoted.
translations.idiomatic: Punished officials and former clerks could not be nominated; violators faced suspension.

sentences.zh: 丙子，令宰臣宣敕：百僚遊宴過從餞別，此後所由不得奏報，務從歡泰。

translations.literal: On bingzi the chancellors were ordered to proclaim an edict: henceforth officials must not memorialize banquets, farewells, and social going among the hundred offices — pursue only glad ease.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi officials were told not to report one another's banquets — enjoy them privately.

sentences.zh: 保義軍節度使劉澭卒。

translations.literal: Baoyi army commissioner Liu Zong died.
translations.idiomatic: Baoyi commissioner Liu Zong died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，史官李吉甫撰《元和國計簿》，總計天下方鎮凡四十八，管州府二百九十五，縣一千四百五十三，戶二百四十四萬二百五十四，其鳳翔、鄜坊、邠甯、振武、涇原、銀夏、靈鹽、河東、易定、魏博、鎮冀、范陽、滄景、淮西、淄青十五道，凡七十一州，不申戶口。

translations.literal: On jimao Historiographer Li Jifu compiled the "Yuanhe National Accounts Book," totaling forty-eight frontier commands, two hundred ninety-five prefectures and circuits, one thousand four hundred fifty-three counties, two million four hundred forty thousand two hundred fifty-four households — of which Fengxiang, Zheng-Fang, Bin-Ning, Zhenwu, Jingyuan, Yin-Xia, Ling-Salt, Hedong, Yiding, Weibo, Zhen-Ji, Fanyang, Cang-Jing, Huaixi, and Zi-Qing fifteen circuits, seventy-one prefectures, did not report households.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Jifu's Yuanhe accounts tallied forty-eight commands — fifteen frontier circuits reported no households.

sentences.zh: 每歲賦入倚辦，止於浙江東西、宣歙、淮南、江西、鄂岳、福建、湖南等八道，合四十九州，一百四十四萬戶。

translations.literal: Each year's tax revenue relied on only Zhejiang East and West, Xuan-She, Huainan, Jiangxi, E-Yue, Fujian, and Hunan eight circuits — forty-nine prefectures, one million four hundred forty thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes now rested on eight southeastern circuits and 1.44 million households.

sentences.zh: 比量天寶供稅之戶，則四分有一。

translations.literal: Compared with Tianbao tax-paying households, it was one in four.
translations.idiomatic: That was a quarter of Tianbao tax households.

sentences.zh: 天下兵戎仰給縣官者八十三萬餘人，比量天寶士馬，則三分加一，率以兩戶資一兵。

translations.literal: Armies and guards depending on the state numbered more than eight hundred thirty thousand — compared with Tianbao soldiers and horses, three parts plus one; on average two households supported one soldier.
translations.idiomatic: Eight hundred thirty thousand men-at-arms consumed three times Tianbao's armies — two households per soldier.

sentences.zh: 其他水旱所損，征科發斂，又在常役之外。

translations.literal: Other flood and drought losses, levies and collections, were again beyond regular corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Floods, droughts, and extra levies lay beyond regular corvée.

sentences.zh: 吉甫都纂其事，成書十卷。

translations.literal: Jifu compiled the matter in all and completed a book of ten scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: Jifu finished the work in ten scrolls.

sentences.zh: 是歲，吐蕃、回紇、奚、契丹、渤海、牂柯、南詔並朝貢。

translations.literal: That year Tibet, Uighur, Xi, Khitan, Bohai, Zangke, and Nanzhao all sent tribute missions.
translations.idiomatic: That year Tibet, Uighurs, Xi, Khitan, Bohai, Zangke, and Nanzhao all paid tribute.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月癸未朔。

translations.literal: Third year, spring, first month, guiwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 3, spring, first month, guiwei new moon.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，群臣上尊號曰睿聖文武皇帝。

translations.literal: On guisi the hundred officials offered the honorific title Sagely Martial Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi the court offered the title Sagely Martial Emperor.

sentences.zh: 禦宣政殿受冊，禮畢，移仗禦丹鳳樓，大赦天下。

translations.literal: He received the seal at Xuanzheng Hall; when ritual ended he moved the guard to Danfeng Tower and proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: He took the seal at Xuanzheng, then amnestied the realm from Danfeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 庚子，涇原段祐請修臨涇城，在涇州北九十里，扼犬戎之沖要，詔從之。

translations.literal: On gengzi Jingyuan's Duan You requested repair of Linyuan city, ninety li north of Jing prefecture, choking the Tujue frontier pass — edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Duan You won approval to rebuild Linyuan on the Jing frontier.

sentences.zh: 戊申，罷左右神威軍，合為一，號天威軍。

translations.literal: On wushen Left and Right Divine Awe armies were abolished and merged into one, titled Heavenly Awe Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the Divine Awe armies merged into the Heavenly Awe Army.

sentences.zh: 二月丙申，宰相李吉甫進封趙國公。

translations.literal: Second month, bingshen: Chancellor Li Jifu advanced to Duke of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Second month, bingshen: Li Jifu became Duke of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以武昌軍節度使韓皋為潤州刺史、鎮海軍節度、浙西觀察使。

translations.literal: On jichou Wuchang commissioner Han Gao was made Run prefect, Zhenhai army commissioner, and Zhexi observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Han Gao took Run and Zhexi.

sentences.zh: 辛未，贈故布衣崔善真睦州司馬，忠諫而死于李錡也。

translations.literal: On xinwei the late commoner Cui Shanzhen of Mu prefecture was posthumously made Mu prefecture vice marshal — loyal remonstrance and death at Li Qi's hands.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Cui Shanzhen, killed remonstrating against Li Qi, was posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以鄜坊節度使裴玢為興元尹、山南西道節度使。

translations.literal: On guichou Zheng-Fang commissioner Pei Bin was made Xingyuan Intendant and Shannan West commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Pei Bin went to Shannan West.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以右金吾衛大將軍路恕為鄜州刺史、鄜坊節度使。

translations.literal: On bingzi Right Golden Guards great general Lu Shu was made Zheng prefect and Zheng-Fang commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Lu Shu took Zheng-Fang.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，咸安大長公主卒于回紇。

translations.literal: On wuyin Princess Xian'an the Great Long died among the Uighurs.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Princess Xian'an died in the Uighur lands.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，郇王總薨。

translations.literal: Third month, guisi: Prince of Ye Zong died.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, guisi: Prince Ye Zong died.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以定平鎮兵馬使硃士明為四鎮、北庭、涇原等州節度使。

translations.literal: On gengzi Dingping garrison commander Zhu Shiming was made commissioner of the Four Garrisons, Northern Court, Jingyuan, and related prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Zhu Shiming took the northwest frontier command.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，禦宣政殿試製科舉人。

translations.literal: On yisi the Emperor at Xuanzheng Hall tested decree-examination candidates.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi decree-examination candidates were tested at Xuanzheng.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸丑，中使郭裏旻酒醉犯夜，杖殺之，金吾薛伾、巡使韋纁皆貶逐。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, guichou: Inner attendant Guo Limin, drunk, violated the night curfew and was beaten to death; Golden Guards Xue Yi and patrol officer Wei Xi were both demoted and expelled.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guichou: a drunken eunuch was beaten to death; two officers were punished.

sentences.zh: 賜硃士明名曰忠亮。

translations.literal: Zhu Shiming was granted the name Zhongliang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Shiming received the name Zhongliang.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，貶翰林學士王涯虢州司馬，時涯甥皇甫湜與牛僧孺、李宗閔並登賢良方正科第三等，策語太切，權幸惡之，故涯坐親累貶之。

translations.literal: On yichou Hanlin academician Wang Ya was demoted to Guo prefecture vice marshal — at the time Ya's nephew Huangfu Shi with Niu Sengru and Li Zongmin all placed third in the Exemplary and Upright examination; the policy language was too cutting and the powerful hated them, so Ya was demoted through kinship.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Wang Ya fell when his nephew's sharp examination answers angered the powerful.

sentences.zh: 壬申，大風毀含元殿欄檻二十七間。

translations.literal: On renshen a great wind destroyed twenty-seven bays of Hanyuan Hall's balustrades.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen wind wrecked twenty-seven bays of Hanyuan balustrades.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以嶺南節度使趙昌為江陵尹、荊南節度使，以戶部侍郎楊于陵為廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On yihai Lingnan commissioner Zhao Chang was made Jiangling Intendant and Jingnan commissioner; Revenue Vice Minister Yang Yuling was made Guangzhou prefect and Lingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Zhao Chang and Yang Yuling swapped Jiangnan and Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以荊南節度使裴均為左僕射、判度支。

translations.literal: On dingchou Jingnan commissioner Pei Jun was made Left Vice Director and acting revenue commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Pei Jun became Left Vice Director over revenue.

sentences.zh: 敕五月一日禦殿受朝賀禮宜停。

translations.literal: An edict: the fifth month's first-day imperial audience congratulatory ritual should cease.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth-month court congratulatory audience was abolished.

sentences.zh: 己卯，裴均於尚書省都堂上僕射。

translations.literal: On jimao Pei Jun at the Secretariat's main hall assumed the vice-directorship.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Pei Jun took the vice-directorship at the Secretariat hall.

sentences.zh: 其送印及呈孔目唱案授案，皆尚書郎為之，文武三品已上升階列坐，四品五品及郎官、御史拜於廳下，然後召御史中丞、左右丞、侍郎升階答拜。

translations.literal: Delivery of the seal and presentation of the roster, announcement, and handing of documents were all done by Secretariat gentlemen; civil and military third rank and above ascended and sat in ranks; fourth and fifth rank, gentlemen, and censors bowed in the hall, then the Vice Censor-in-Chief, Left and Right Vice Directors, and vice ministers were summoned to ascend and return bows.
translations.idiomatic: The elaborate ceremony had secretariat gentlemen handle every step while ranks bowed in sequence.

sentences.zh: 雖修故事行之，議者論其太過。

translations.literal: Though the old story was followed, critics said it was excessive.
translations.idiomatic: Observers called the ritual excessive.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，兵部請復武舉，從之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, renchen: War Department requested restoration of the military examination — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, renchen: the military examination was restored.

sentences.zh: 甲午，敕東都畿、汝州都防禦使及副使宜停，所管將士三千七百三十人，隨畿、汝界分留守及汝州防禦使分掌之。

translations.literal: On jiawu an edict: Eastern Capital metropolitan Ji and Ruzhou overall defense commissioner and deputy should cease; their three thousand seven hundred thirty troops should be divided between the metropolitan regent and Ruzhou defense commissioner by Ji and Ru boundaries.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Ji-Ru defense post was abolished and its troops split.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，右僕射裴均請取荊南雜錢萬貫修尚書省，從之。

translations.literal: On xinchou Right Vice Director Pei Jun requested ten thousand strings of Jingnan miscellaneous cash to repair the Secretariat — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Pei Jun took ten thousand strings from Jingnan to repair the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 丙午，正衙冊九姓回紇可汗為登囉裏汨蜜施合毗伽保義可汗。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the main court the Nine Surnames' Uighur qaghan was enfeoffed Tengri Bolu Mishi Hehu Piqie Huaixin Qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the Uighur qaghan was enfeoffed in the main court.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，詔以錢少，欲設畜錢之令，先告諭天下商貢畜錢者，並令逐便市易，不得畜錢。

translations.literal: Sixth month, wuchen: an edict, because money was scarce, wished to establish a hoarding-money ordinance; first proclaim to all under Heaven that merchants hoarding money must promptly trade at market and may not hoard money.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, wuchen: a hoarding-money ban was proclaimed before scarcity measures.

sentences.zh: 天下銀坑，不得私扌采。

translations.literal: Silver mines throughout the empire may not be privately mined.
translations.idiomatic: Private silver mining was forbidden empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以邕管將黃少卿為歸順州刺史，弟少高、少溫並授官，西原蠻酋也，貞元中屢寇邕管，至是歸款。

translations.literal: On guihai Yongguan general Huang Shaoqing was made Guishun prefect; younger brothers Shaogao and Shaowen were also granted office — chiefs of the Western Yuan barbarians who in Zhenyuan had repeatedly raided Yongguan, now submitting.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Western Yuan chiefs who had raided Yongguan were enfeoffed after submission.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，罷江淮私堰埭二十二，從轉運使奏也。

translations.literal: On yichou twenty-two private Jiang-Huai dams and embankments were abolished — following the transport commissioner's memorial.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou twenty-two private Jiang-Huai dams were torn down on the transport commissioner's advice.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以河南尹關除慶為東都留守。

translations.literal: On jiaxu Henan Intendant Guan Chuqing was made Eastern Capital regent.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Guan Chuqing became Luoyang regent.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，沙陀、突厥七百人攜其親屬歸振武節度伎範希朝，乃授其大首領曷勒河波陰山府都督。

translations.literal: On dingchou seven hundred Shatuo and Tujue brought kin and submitted to Zhenwu commissioner Fan Xichao; their great chief was made Yinshan prefecture protector.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou seven hundred Shatuo and Turks submitted to Fan Xichao; their chief became Yinshan protector.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛巳朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, xinsi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinsi new moon: eclipse.

sentences.zh: 己亥，復以度支安邑、解縣兩池留後為榷鹽使。

translations.literal: On jihai the Anyi and Jie county salt-pool deputies of revenue were again made salt monopoly commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Anyi and Jie salt pools regained monopoly commissioners.

sentences.zh: 丁未，涪州復隸黔中道。

translations.literal: On dingwei Fu prefecture was again placed under Qianzhong circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Fu prefecture returned to Qianzhong circuit.

sentences.zh: 八月庚申，復置東都防禦兵七百人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, gengshen: Eastern Capital defense troops of seven hundred were restored.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, gengshen: seven hundred Luoyang defense troops were restored.

sentences.zh: 九月己丑，淮南節度使王鍔來朝。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jichou: Huainan commissioner Wang E came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jichou: Wang E of Huainan came to court.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以山南東道節度使于頔守司空、同平章事；

translations.literal: On gengyin Shannan East commissioner Yu Di was made acting Minister of Works and Grand Councilor;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Yu Di became acting Works minister and councilor;

sentences.zh: 以右僕射裴均檢校左僕射、同平章事、襄州長史，充山南東道節度使；

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Pei Jun was made acting Left Vice Director, Grand Councilor, and Xiangzhou senior administrator, Shannan East commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Pei Jun moved to Shannan East as councilor;

sentences.zh: 加宣武韓弘同平章事。

translations.literal: Xuanwu's Han Hong was advanced to Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Han Hong of Xuanwu joined the council.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以戶部侍郎裴洎為中書侍郎、同平章事。

translations.literal: On bingshen Revenue Vice Minister Pei Ji was made Vice Director and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Pei Ji entered the council.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以中書侍郎、平章事李吉甫檢校兵部尚書、兼中書侍郎、平章事、揚州大都督府長史、淮南節度使。

translations.literal: On wuxu Vice Director and Grand Councilor Li Jifu was made acting War Minister, concurrent Vice Director, Grand Councilor, Yangzhou metropolitan senior administrator, and Huainan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Li Jifu went to Huainan as councilor.

sentences.zh: 以淮南節度使王鍔檢校司徒、河中尹、河中晉絳慈隰節度使。

translations.literal: Huainan commissioner Wang E was made acting Grand Mentor, Hedong Intendant, and Hedong Jin- Jiang- Ci- Long commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang E of Huainan succeeded Du Huangxiang at Hedong.

sentences.zh: 河中節度使、檢校司空、同平章事邠國公杜黃裳卒。

translations.literal: Hedong commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor, Duke of Bin Du Huangxiang died.
translations.idiomatic: Du Huangxiang of Hedong died.

sentences.zh: 是秋，京師大雨。

translations.literal: That autumn the capital region had great rain.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn Chang'an saw heavy rains.

sentences.zh: 十月己酉朔。

translations.literal: Tenth month, jiyou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth month opened on jiyou.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，乙太常卿高郢為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On guihai Acting Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director Gao Ying was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Gao Ying became Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以御史中丞竇群為湖南觀察使，既行，改為黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiazi Censor-in-Chief Dou Qun was made Hunan observer; after he had departed he was changed to Qianzhong observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Dou Qun was sent to Hunan, then reassigned to Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 群初為李吉甫所擢用，及持憲，反傾吉甫，吉甫謐其陰事，故貶之。

translations.literal: Qun had first been promoted by Li Jifu; once holding the censorate he turned against Jifu — Jifu exposed his secret matters, hence the demotion.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Qun had been Jifu's protégé until he turned censor against him and was exiled.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，度支使下判案官，以四員為定。

translations.literal: On dingmao the revenue commissioner fixed subordinate case officers at four posts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao revenue subordinate posts were fixed at four.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲午，橫海軍節度使程執恭來朝。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, jiawu: Heng-Hai commissioner Cheng Zhigong came to court.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jiawu: Cheng Zhigong of Heng-Hai came to court.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，以臨涇縣為行原州，命鎮將郝玼為刺史。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, gengxu: Linyuan county was made acting Yuan prefecture; garrison commander Hao Yu was named prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, gengxu: Linyuan became acting Yuanzhou with Hao Yu as prefect.

sentences.zh: 自玼鎮臨涇，西戎不敢犯塞。

translations.literal: From the time Yu garrisoned Linyuan, the Western Rong did not dare violate the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hao Yu the western barbarians did not raid the passes.

sentences.zh: 甲子，南詔異牟尋卒。

translations.literal: On jiazi Nanzhao's Yimouxun died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi the Nanzhao king Yimouxun died.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以諫議大夫段平仲使南詔弔祭，仍立其子驃信苴蒙閣勸為南詔王。

translations.literal: On xinwei Remonstrating Censor Duan Pingzhong was sent to Nanzhao to mourn and sacrifice, and still to install his son Piaoxin Jumengge as Nanzhao king.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Duan Pingzhong mourned in Nanzhao and enthroned Yimouxun's son.

sentences.zh: 是歲，淮南、江南、江西、湖南、山南東道旱。

translations.literal: That year Huainan, Jiangnan, Jiangxi, Hunan, and Shannan East circuits suffered drought.
translations.idiomatic: That year drought struck the southeast circuits.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丙子朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, bingzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the fourth month opened on bingzi.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，國子祭酒馮伉卒。

translations.literal: On wuyin Directorate of Education Director Feng Kang died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Feng Kang died.

sentences.zh: 壬午，裴均進銀器一千五百兩，以違敕，付左藏庫。

translations.literal: On renwu Pei Jun presented one thousand five hundred liang of silver vessels — for violating an edict they were sent to the Left Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Pei Jun's silver gift was confiscated for breaching an edict.

sentences.zh: 甲申，令皇太子居少陽院。

translations.literal: On jiashen the heir apparent was ordered to reside in the Shaoyang quarter.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the crown prince moved to Shaoyang quarter.

sentences.zh: 武功人張英奴撰《回波辭》惑眾，杖殺之。

translations.literal: Zhang Yingnu of Wugong composed "Wave-Return Lyrics" to delude the masses and was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yingnu of Wugong was executed for seductive "Wave-Return" songs.

sentences.zh: 丙申，撫州山人張洪騎牛冠履，獻書於光順門，書不足采，遣之。

translations.literal: On bingshen Fuzhou mountain man Zhang Hong rode an ox wearing cap and shoes and presented a book at Guangshun Gate — the book was unworthy of acceptance and he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen a Fuzhou eccentric presented a worthless book at Guangshun Gate and was sent away.

sentences.zh: 庚子，制故太尉、西平郡王李晟宜編附屬籍。

translations.literal: On gengzi an edict: the late Grand Preceptor, Prince of Xiping Li Sheng should be entered in the attached clan register.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Sheng was ordered entered in the imperial clan register.

sentences.zh: 乙太常卿李元素為戶部尚書、判度支，以商州刺史元義方為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: Acting Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director Li Yuansu was made Revenue Minister and acting revenue commissioner; Shang prefect Yuan Yifang was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuansu took revenue; Yuan Yifang took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以兵部侍郎權德輿為太常卿，仍賜金紫。

translations.literal: On jiachen War Vice Minister Quan Deyu was made Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director, still granted gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Quan Deyu became Court of Sacrifices director with gold-purple.

sentences.zh: 以御史大夫高郢為兵部尚書，以刑部郎中、侍御史知雜李夷簡為御史中丞。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Gao Ying was made War Minister; Penal Department bureau director and attendant censor knowing miscellaneous Li Yijian was made Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Ying became War Minister; Li Yijian became Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, bingwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on bingwu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，刑部尚書鄭元卒。

translations.literal: On xinyou Penal Minister Zheng Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Zheng Yuan died.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，鹽鐵使、吏部尚書李巽卒。

translations.literal: On dingmao Salt and Iron commissioner and War Minister Li Xun died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Li Xun died.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, yihai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on yihai.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以河東節度使李鄘為刑部尚書以充諸道鹽鐵轉運使；

translations.literal: On dingchou Hedong commissioner Li Yong was made Penal Minister and overall salt-iron transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Yong took salt-iron transport;

sentences.zh: 以靈鹽節度使范希朝為太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使；

translations.literal: Ling-Salt commissioner Fan Xichao was made Taiyuan Intendant, Northern Capital regent, and Hedong commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Xichao went to Hedong;

sentences.zh: 以右衛上將軍王佖為靈州大都督府長史、靈鹽節度使。

translations.literal: Right Guard senior general Wang Yi was made Ling metropolitan senior administrator and Ling-Salt commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Yi took Ling-Salt.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，五嶺已北銀坑任人開採，禁錢不過嶺南。

translations.literal: On xinchou north of the Five Ranges silver mines were opened to private mining; coin was forbidden south of the ranges.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou private mining was allowed north of the Five Ranges; coin could not cross south.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙巳朔，禦制《前代君臣事蹟》十四篇，書于六扇屏風。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, yisi new moon: the Emperor composed in his own hand fourteen chapters of "Former Ages' Monarch and Minister Deeds," written on six folding screens.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yisi new moon: the Emperor wrote fourteen moral chapters on six screens.

sentences.zh: 是月，出書屏以示宰臣，李籓等表謝之。

translations.literal: That month the book screens were shown to the chancellors; Li Fan and others memorialized thanks.
translations.idiomatic: That month the chancellors were shown the screens and thanked him.

sentences.zh: 丁未，渭南暴水，壞廬舍二百餘戶，溺死六百人，命府司賑給。

translations.literal: On dingwei Weinan sudden flood destroyed more than two hundred dwellings and drowned six hundred people — the prefectural office was ordered to relieve and supply.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei a Weinan flash flood killed six hundred; relief was ordered.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，右羽林統軍高固卒。

translations.literal: On yimao Right Feathered Forest commander-in-chief Gao Gu died.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Gao Gu died.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，御史中丞李夷簡彈京兆尹楊憑前為江西觀察使時贓罪，貶憑臨賀尉。

translations.literal: On renxu Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yijian impeached Capital Intendant Yang Ping for embezzlement when Jiangxi observer — Ping was demoted to Linhe district captain.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Li Yijian toppled Yang Ping for Jiangxi graft.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以尚書右丞許孟容為京兆尹，賜金紫。

translations.literal: On wuchen Right Secretariat Vice Director Xu Mengong was made Capital Intendant and granted gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Xu Mengong became Capital Intendant with gold-purple.

sentences.zh: 八月甲戌朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiaxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on jiaxu.

sentences.zh: 癸未，兗州魚台縣移置於黃台市。

translations.literal: On guiwei Yanzhou's Yutai county seat was moved to Huangtai market.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Yutai county was moved to Huangtai market.

sentences.zh: 丙申，安南都護張舟奏破環王國三萬餘人，獲戰象、兵械，並王子五十九人。

translations.literal: On bingshen Annan protector Zhang Zhou memorialized breaking the Huan kingdom, more than thirty thousand men, capturing war elephants, weapons, and fifty-nine princes.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Zhang Zhou reported crushing Huan with thirty thousand captives.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，贈太師裴冕宜配享代宗廟庭，贈太師李晟、贈太尉段秀實宜配享德宗廟庭。

translations.literal: On guimao posthumous Grand Preceptor Pei Mian should share sacrifice in Emperor Daizong's temple; posthumous Grand Preceptor Li Sheng and posthumous Grand Preceptor Duan Xiushi should share sacrifice in Emperor Dezong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Pei Mian, Li Sheng, and Duan Xiushi were ordered into imperial temples.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰朔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, jiachen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on jiachen.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以成德軍都知兵馬使、鎮府右司馬王承宗起復檢校工部尚書，充成德軍節度使；

translations.literal: On gengxu Chengde army overall military commander and Zhen prefecture Right Senior Administrator Wang Chengzong was recalled to acting Works Minister and made Chengde commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wang Chengzong was recalled to Chengde command;

sentences.zh: 以德州刺史薛昌朝檢校左常侍，充保信軍節度、德棣等州觀察等使。

translations.literal: Dezhou prefect Xue Changchao was made acting Left Regular Attendant, Baoxin army commissioner, and De-Qi observer.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Changchao was made Baoxin commissioner over De and Qi.

sentences.zh: 昌朝，薛嵩之子，婚于王氏，時為德州刺史。

translations.literal: Changchao was Xue Song's son, married into the Wang clan, and at the time was Dezhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: Changchao was Xue Song's son-in-law of Wang and held Dezhou.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以承宗難制，乃割二州為節度，以授昌朝。

translations.literal: The court, because Chengzong was hard to control, carved out two prefectures as a command and gave it to Changchao.
translations.idiomatic: The court split De and Qi from Chengde for Changchao to tame Chengzong.

sentences.zh: 制才下，承宗以兵虜昌朝歸鎮州。

translations.literal: The edict had barely been issued when Chengzong with troops seized Changchao and returned him to Zhen prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The edict had barely left when Chengzong seized Changchao back to Zhenzhou.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，邠甯節度使、檢校司空、同平章事高崇文卒。

translations.literal: On dingmao Bin-Ning commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor Gao Chongwen died.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Gao Chongwen of Bin-Ning died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉朔，以右羽林統軍閻巨源為邠州刺史、邠甯慶節度使，以少府監崔頲為同州刺史、本州防禦、長春宮等使、癸未，詔：「成德軍節度使王承宗頃在苫廬，潛窺戎鎮。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, guiyou new moon: Right Feathered Forest commander Yan Juyuan was made Bin prefect and Bin-Ning-Qing commissioner; Junior Palace Director Cui Ying was made Tong prefect, that prefecture's defense commissioner, and Changchun Palace commissioner; guiwei, edict: "Chengde commissioner Wang Chengzong, while in mourning garb, secretly watched the military post.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, guiyou: Yan Juyuan took Bin-Ning; on guiwei an edict denounced Wang Chengzong's mourning treachery.

sentences.zh: 而內外以事君之禮，叛而必誅；

translations.literal: Yet inwardly and outwardly the ritual of serving the ruler holds that rebellion must be punished;
translations.idiomatic: Court ritual demanded punishment for rebellion;

sentences.zh: 分土之儀，專則有辟。

translations.literal: the ritual of dividing territory holds that usurpation brings execution.
translations.idiomatic: usurpation of fiefs likewise meant execution.

sentences.zh: 朕念其先祖嘗有茂勳，貸以私恩，抑於公議。

translations.literal: The Emperor recalled his ancestors' once flourishing merit, granted private favor, yet checked public opinion.
translations.idiomatic: The throne weighed ancestral merit against public law.

sentences.zh: 使臣旁午以告諭，孽童俯伏以陳誠，願獻兩州，期無二事。

translations.literal: Envoys came one after another to instruct; the wicked youth bowed to declare sincerity, wishing to yield two prefectures and promise no second affair.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys had urged him; he had bowed and promised two prefectures.

sentences.zh: 朕亦收其後效，用以曲全，授節制於舊疆，齒勳賢於列位。

translations.literal: The Emperor also accepted his later effect, using it to bend and preserve him, granting command within the old borders and ranking him among the meritorious.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor had hoped to preserve him with an old-border commission.

sentences.zh: 況德、棣本非成德所管，昌朝又是承宗懿親，俾撫近鄰，斯誠厚澤，外雖兩鎮，內是一家。

translations.literal: Moreover De and Qi were never Chengde's to administer; Changchao was moreover Chengzong's close kin — to soothe a near neighbor was truly thick grace; outwardly two commands, inwardly one house.
translations.idiomatic: De and Qi were not Chengde's; giving kin Changchao nearby seemed generous — yet one house ruled both.

sentences.zh: 而承宗象恭懷奸，肖貌稔惡，欺裴武於得位之後，囚昌朝於授命之中。

translations.literal: Yet Chengzong feigned respect while cherishing treachery, his face and conduct long steeped in evil — he deceived Pei Wu after gaining the post and imprisoned Changchao in the midst of the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: He feigned respect, tricked Pei Wu, and seized Changchao mid-appointment.

sentences.zh: 加以表疏之章，悖慢斯甚，義士之所興歎，天地之所不容。

translations.literal: Moreover his memorial language was insolent beyond measure — what righteous men sigh at, what Heaven and Earth cannot contain.
translations.idiomatic: His memorials grew insolent beyond what heaven could bear.

sentences.zh: 恭行天誅，蓋示朝典，承宗在身官爵，並宜削奪。

translations.literal: Reverently executing Heaven's punishment displays the court's law; Chengzong's personal offices and titles are all to be stripped.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven's punishment was proclaimed; all Chengzong's ranks were stripped.

sentences.zh: 」以神策左軍中尉吐突承璀為鎮州行營招討處置等使，以龍武將軍趙萬敵為神策先鋒將，內官宋惟澄、曹進玉、馬朝江等為行營館驛糧料等使。

translations.literal: Shence Left Army Commandant Tutu Chengcui was made Zhenzhou campaign commander and disposition commissioner; Dragon Martial general Zhao Wandi was made Shence vanguard general; inner attendants Song Weicheng, Cao Jinyu, Ma Chaojiang, and others were made campaign hostel grain commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Tutu Chengcui led the Zhen campaign with Zhao Wandi as vanguard.

sentences.zh: 京兆尹許孟容與諫官面論，征伐大事，不可以內官為將帥，補闕獨孤鬱其言激切。

translations.literal: Capital Intendant Xu Mengong with remonstrating officials argued face to face that great punitive expeditions must not use inner attendants as commanders; Remonstrance Aide Du Gu's words were especially cutting.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Mengong and remonstrators protested eunuch generals on a great campaign.

sentences.zh: 詔旨只改處置為宣慰，猶存招討之名。

translations.literal: The edict only changed disposition to consolation, yet still kept the campaign name.
translations.idiomatic: The title was softened to "consolation" but "campaign" remained.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔軍進討，其王武俊、士真墳墓，軍士不得樵采，其士平、士則各守本官，仍令士則各襲武俊之封。

translations.literal: On jichou an edict: as the army advances, Wang Wujun's and Wang Shizhen's tombs — soldiers may not gather firewood; Shi Ping and Shi Ze each keep their original offices, and Shi Ze is still to inherit Wujun's enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou the army was forbidden to desecrate Wang clan tombs; loyal Wang kin were spared.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，冊鄧王甯為皇太子。

translations.literal: On gengyin Prince of Deng Ning was enfeoffed crown prince.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince Deng Ning became crown prince.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以冊儲，肆赦系囚，死罪降從流，流以下遞降一等。

translations.literal: On guisi because of the investiture, a general amnesty for bound prisoners — capital crimes reduced to exile, exile and below each reduced one grade.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi investiture brought amnesty lowering capital crimes to exile.

sentences.zh: 文武常參官、外州府長官子為父後者，賜勳兩轉。

translations.literal: Civil and military regular attendees and outer prefecture and circuit chiefs' sons succeeding fathers were granted two merit turns.
translations.idiomatic: Regular attendees and heirs of frontier chiefs gained two merit turns.

sentences.zh: 工部侍郎歸登、給事中呂元膺為皇太子諸王侍讀。

translations.literal: Works Vice Minister Gui Deng and Drafting Editor Lü Yuanying were made crown prince and princes' lecturers.
translations.idiomatic: Gui Deng and Lü Yuanying became lecturers to the heir and princes.

sentences.zh: 己亥，吐突承璀軍發京師，上御通化門勞遣之。

translations.literal: On jihai Tutu Chengcui's army departed the capital; the Emperor came to Tonghua Gate to console and send them off.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai the Emperor saw Chengcui's army off at Tonghua Gate.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸卯朔，浙西蘇、潤、常州旱儉，賑米二萬石。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, guimao new moon: Zhexi Su, Run, and Chang prefectures suffered drought and dearth — two ten thousand shi of relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Su, Run, and Chang received twenty thousand shi of famine grain.

sentences.zh: 甲子，河南尹杜兼卒。

translations.literal: On jiazi Henan Intendant Du Jian died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Du Jian died.

sentences.zh: 己巳，彰義軍節度使、檢校司空、同平章事吳少誠卒。

translations.literal: On jisi Zhangyi commissioner, acting Minister of Works, Grand Councilor Wu Shaocheng died.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Wu Shaocheng of Zhangyi died.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申朔，以戶部侍郎張弘靖為陝府長史、陝虢觀察陸運等使，賜金紫。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, renshen new moon: Revenue Vice Minister Zhang Hongjing was made Shaanfu senior administrator, Shaan-Guo observer and land-and-water transport commissioner, granted gold-purple.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month: Zhang Hongjing took Shaan-Guo transport.

sentences.zh: 以陝虢觀察使房式為河南尹。

translations.literal: Shaan-Guo observer Fang Shi was made Henan Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Shi became Henan Intendant.

sentences.zh: 中丞李夷簡奏：「諸州府於兩稅外違格科率，請諸道鹽鐵、轉運、度支、巡院察訪報台司，以憑舉奏。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yijian memorialized: "Prefectures and circuits beyond the two-tax quota levies — request salt-iron, transport, revenue, and inspection offices to investigate and report to the Censorate for impeachment."
translations.idiomatic: Li Yijian asked inspectors to report illegal levies beyond the two-tax quota.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was approved.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月壬寅朔，己巳，浙西觀察使韓皋以杖決安吉令孫澥致死，有乖典法，罰一月俸料。

translations.literal: Fifth year, spring, first month, renyin new moon; on jisi Zhexi observer Han Gao, for beating Anji magistrate Sun Xie to death with the staff, violating canonical law, was fined one month's salary.
translations.idiomatic: Year 5, first month: Han Gao was fined a month for beating a magistrate to death.

sentences.zh: 二月辛未朔。

translations.literal: Second month, xinwei new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on xinwei.

sentences.zh: 戊子，禮院奏東宮殿閣名及宮臣姓名，與太子名同者改之，其上臺官列、王官爵土無例輒改，從之。

translations.literal: On wuzi the Rites Court memorialized: Eastern Palace hall and pavilion names and palace officers' personal names matching the heir's name should be changed; superior terrace official ranks and royal enfeoffments and fiefs without precedent must not be changed at will — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi taboo names in the Eastern Palace were ordered changed.

sentences.zh: 東台監察御史元稹攝河南尹房式於台，擅令停務，貶江陵府士曹參軍。

translations.literal: Eastern Terrace investigating censor Yuan Zhen at the Censorate detained Henan Intendant Fang Shi, on his own authority ordering cessation of duties — demoted to Jiangling prefecture army adjutant.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhen detained Fang Shi and was demoted to Jiangling adjutant.

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑朔，宰相杜祐與同列宴于樊川別墅，上遣中使賜酒饌。

translations.literal: Third month, xinchou new moon: Chancellor Du You banqueted with colleagues at Fanchuan villa; the Emperor sent inner attendants with wine and viands.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Du You's Fanchuan banquet received imperial wine from the throne.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以御史中丞李夷簡為戶部侍郎、判度支，以兵部侍郎王播為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On yisi Vice Censor-in-Chief Li Yijian was made Revenue Vice Minister and acting revenue commissioner; War Vice Minister Wang Bo was made Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Li Yijian took revenue; Wang Bo took the censorate.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以太子賓客鄭絪檢校禮部尚書、廣州刺史、嶺南節度使。

translations.literal: On guisi Crown Prince Guest Zheng Yin was made acting Rites Minister, Guangzhou prefect, and Lingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zheng Yin went to Lingnan.

sentences.zh: 己未，制以遂王宥為彰義軍節度使，以申州刺史吳少陽為申光蔡節度留後。

translations.literal: On jiwei an edict made Prince of Sui You Zhangyi commissioner; Shen prefect Wu Shaoyang was made Shen-Guang-Cai commissioner acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Prince You took Zhangyi; Wu Shaoyang succeeded Wu Shaocheng.

sentences.zh: 甲子，大風折木。

translations.literal: On jiazi a great wind broke trees.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi a gale broke trees.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，宰相于頔請依杜祐例一月三朝，從之。

translations.literal: On dingmao Chancellor Yu Di requested following Du You's precedent of three court audiences per month — approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Yu Di won thrice-monthly audiences like Du You.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚午朔。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, gengwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the fourth month opened on gengwu.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，戶部尚書李元素卒。

translations.literal: On guiyou Revenue Minister Li Yuansu died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Yuansu died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，鎮州行營招討使吐突承璀執昭義節度使盧從史，載從史送京師。

translations.literal: On jiashen Zhenzhou campaign commander Tutu Chengcui seized Zhaoyi commissioner Lu Congshi and sent Congshi to the capital under guard.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Chengcui seized Lu Congshi of Zhaoyi and sent him captive.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，河東範希朝奏破賊於木刀溝。

translations.literal: On dinghai Hedong Fan Xichao memorialized defeating bandits at Mudao Ravine.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Fan Xichao reported victory at Mudao Ravine.

sentences.zh: 福州復置侯官、長樂二縣，建州置將樂縣。

translations.literal: Fuzhou restored Houguan and Changle counties; Jianzhou established Jiangle county.
translations.idiomatic: Fuzhou and Jianzhou regained or gained counties.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以昭義都知兵馬使、潞州左司馬烏重胤為懷州刺史、河陽三城懷州節度使，以河陽節度使孟元陽為潞州長史、昭義軍節度、澤潞磁邢洺觀察使。

translations.literal: On renshen Zhaoyi overall military commander and Lu prefecture Left Senior Administrator Wu Chongyin was made Huai prefect and Heyang Three Cities Huai commissioner; Heyang commissioner Meng Yuanyang was made Lu senior administrator, Zhaoyi commissioner, and Ze-Lu-Ci-Xing-Mo observer.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Wu Chongyin and Meng Yuanyang swapped Heyang and Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，貶前昭義節度使盧從史為驩州司馬。

translations.literal: On wuxu former Zhaoyi commissioner Lu Congshi was demoted to Huan prefecture vice marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Lu Congshi was demoted to Huanzhou.

sentences.zh: 五月庚子朔。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengzi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth month opened on gengzi.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，昭義軍三千人夜潰奔魏州。

translations.literal: On yisi three thousand Zhaoyi troops mutinied at night and fled to Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi three thousand Zhaoyi troops deserted to Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 右神策軍使段祐卒。

translations.literal: Right Shence army commander Duan You died.
translations.idiomatic: Right Shence commander Duan You died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，吐蕃使論思即熱朝貢，並歸鄭叔矩、路泌之柩。

translations.literal: On gengshen a Tibetan envoy, Lun Sinure, came to court with tribute and returned the coffins of Zheng Shuju and Lu Bi.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Tibet returned Zheng Shuju and Lu Bi's coffins with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午朔。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengwu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth month opened on gengwu.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，乙太府卿李少和為洪州刺史、江西觀察使。

translations.literal: On wuyin Acting Court of the Imperial Treasury Director Li Shaohe was made Hong prefect and Jiangxi observer.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Li Shaohe took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 奚、回紇、室韋寇振武。

translations.literal: Xi, Uighur, and Shiwei raided Zhenwu.
translations.idiomatic: Xi, Uighurs, and Shiwei raided Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，應給食實封例，節度使兼宰相，每食實封百戶，歲給八百端匹，若是絹，加給綿六百兩；

translations.literal: On guisi precedent for enfeoffment food grants: commissioners who were also chancellors received one hundred enfeoffment households' food per meal, eight hundred bolts yearly; if silk, an additional six hundred liang of cotton;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi enfeoffment food rules were fixed: chancellor-commissioners received eight hundred bolts yearly per hundred households;

sentences.zh: 節度使不兼宰相，每百戶給四百端匹；

translations.literal: commissioners not also chancellors, four hundred bolts per hundred households;
translations.idiomatic: plain commissioners four hundred bolts;

sentences.zh: 軍使諸衛大將軍，每百戶給三百五十端匹。

translations.literal: army commanders and guards great generals, three hundred fifty bolts per hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: army and guard generals three hundred fifty bolts.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己亥朔。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, jihai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jihai new moon.

sentences.zh: 庚子，承宗遣判官崔遂上表自首，請輸常賦，朝廷除授官吏。

translations.literal: On gengzi Chengzong sent judge Cui Sui to submit a self-accusation memorial, requesting to deliver regular levies and accept court appointment of officials.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Chengzong confessed by memorial and offered taxes and court appointments.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔昭洗王承宗，復其官爵，待之如初。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict washed clean Wang Chengzong, restored his offices and titles, treating him as before.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Chengzong was pardoned and restored.

sentences.zh: 諸道行營將士，共賜物二十八萬四百三十端匹。

translations.literal: Campaign troops of all circuits together were granted goods of two hundred eighty thousand four hundred thirty bolts.
translations.idiomatic: Campaign troops received two hundred eighty thousand bolts of goods.

sentences.zh: 時招討非其人，諸軍解體，而籓鄰觀望養寇，空為逗撓，以弊國賦。

translations.literal: At the time the campaign commander was not the right man; the armies dissolved, while neighboring commands watched and nurtured the bandit, empty delay exhausting state revenue.
translations.idiomatic: The wrong commander had dissolved the armies while neighbors watched and tax revenue bled away.

sentences.zh: 而李師道、劉濟亟請昭雪，乃歸罪盧從史而宥承宗。

translations.literal: Li Shidao and Liu Ji urgently requested clearing Chengzong's name — hence blame fell on Lu Congshi while Chengzong was pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shidao and Liu Ji pressed for Chengzong's pardon — Congshi was blamed instead.

sentences.zh: 不得已而行之也。

translations.literal: It was done because there was no other way.
translations.idiomatic: The court acted because it had no choice.

sentences.zh: 幽州劉濟加中書令，魏博田季安加司徒，淄青李師道加僕射，並以罷兵加賞也。

translations.literal: Youzhou's Liu Ji was advanced to Secretariat Director; Weibo's Tian Ji'an advanced to Grand Mentor; Zi-Qing's Li Shidao advanced to Vice Director — all rewards for ceasing troops.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Ji, Tian Ji'an, and Li Shidao were promoted as rewards for standing down.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，幽州節度使劉濟為其子總鴆死。

translations.literal: On yimao Youzhou commissioner Liu Ji was poisoned to death by his son Zong.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Liu Ji was poisoned by his son Zong.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以虔州刺史馬總為安南都護、本管經略使。

translations.literal: On gengshen Qian prefect Ma Zong was made Annan protector and overall pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Ma Zong took Annan.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳朔。

translations.literal: Eighth month, yisi new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eighth month opened on yisi.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上顧謂宰臣曰：「神仙之事信乎？

translations.literal: On yihai the Emperor looked at the chancellors and said: "Are immortal matters believable?"
