translations.idiomatic: On yihai he asked his chancellors whether immortals were real.

sentences.zh: 李籓對曰：「神仙之說，出於道家；

translations.literal: Li Fan answered: "The immortal theory comes from Daoism;
translations.idiomatic: Li Fan answered that immortality came from Daoism;

sentences.zh: 所宗《老子》五千文為本。

translations.literal: what it reveres is Laozi's five thousand words as foundation.
translations.idiomatic: grounded in Laozi's five thousand words.

sentences.zh: 《老子》指歸，與經無異。

translations.literal: Laozi's purport differs in nothing from the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Laozi's teaching, he said, matched the classics.

sentences.zh: 後代好怪之流，假託老子神仙之說。

translations.literal: Later generations' lovers of the strange falsely borrowed Laozi's immortal talk.
translations.idiomatic: Later wonder-seekers had twisted it into immortality cults.

sentences.zh: 故秦始皇遣方士載男女入海求仙，漢武帝嫁女與方士求不死藥，二主受惑，卒無所得。

translations.literal: Thus Qin Shihuang sent alchemical masters with men and women in boats to seek immortals at sea; Han Wudi married a daughter to an alchemical master seeking the undying drug — both rulers were deluded and in the end gained nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Qin and Han emperors had chased immortals by sea and marriage and gained nothing.

sentences.zh: 文皇帝服胡僧長生藥，遂致暴疾不救。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen took a Hu monk's longevity drug and thereby suffered sudden illness beyond saving.
translations.idiomatic: Even Taizong died from a foreign longevity elixir.

sentences.zh: 古詩云：『服食求神仙，多為藥所誤。

translations.literal: An old poem says: 'Seeking immortals by taking drugs — many are ruined by the drugs.'
translations.idiomatic: An old poem warned that drug-seekers are ruined by drugs.

sentences.zh: 』誠哉是言也。

translations.literal: Truly those words!
translations.idiomatic: Truly so, he said.

sentences.zh: 君人者，但務求理，四海樂推，社稷延永，自然長年也。

translations.literal: A ruler need only seek good governance; when all under Heaven gladly pushes him forward and the altars endure long, naturally he will have long years.
translations.idiomatic: A ruler's longevity lay in good rule, not elixirs.

sentences.zh: 」上深然之。

translations.literal: The Emperor deeply agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Xianzong was deeply persuaded.

sentences.zh: 以浙東觀察使薛蘋為潤州刺史、浙西觀察使，以常州刺史李遜為越州刺史、浙東觀察使。

translations.literal: Zhedong observer Xue Pin was made Run prefect and Zhexi observer; Changzhou prefect Li Xun was made Yue prefect and Zhedong observer.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Pin and Li Xun swapped Zhejiang posts.

sentences.zh: 以都官郎中韋貫之為中書舍人，起居舍人裴度為司封員外郎、知制誥。

translations.literal: Capital Punishments bureau director Wei Guanzhi was made Secretariat Drafting Editor; Diary Editor Pei Du was made Court of the Imperial Clan outer-office gentleman and edict drafter.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guanzhi and Pei Du entered drafting posts.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以鄧州刺史崔詠為邕州刺史、本管經略使。

translations.literal: On guisi Deng prefect Cui Yong was made Yong prefect and overall pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Cui Yong took Yong and pacification command.

sentences.zh: 九月戊戌朔。

translations.literal: Ninth month, wuxu new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth month opened on wuxu.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以吐突承璀復為左軍中尉。

translations.literal: On xinhai Tutu Chengcui was again made Left Army Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Chengcui returned as Left Army Commandant.

sentences.zh: 諫官以承璀建謀討伐無功，請行朝典。

translations.literal: Remonstrating officials, because Chengcui had planned the campaign without achievement, requested court law be applied.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrators demanded punishment for Chengcui's failed campaign.

sentences.zh: 上宥之，降承璀為軍器使。

translations.literal: The Emperor pardoned him and demoted Chengcui to Armory Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor pardoned him but demoted him to Armory Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乃以內官程文幹為左軍中尉。

translations.literal: Then inner attendant Cheng Wengan was made Left Army Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Wengan replaced him as Left Army Commandant.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，以瀛州刺史劉總起復受幽州長史，充幽州盧龍軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renxu Ying prefect Liu Zong, recalled to mourning, received Youzhou senior administrator and Youzhou Lulong commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu Liu Zong took Youzhou in mourning recall.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以兵部尚書高郢為右僕射致仕。

translations.literal: On guihai War Minister Gao Ying was made Right Vice Director and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Gao Ying retired as Right Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，制以正議大夫、守太常卿、上柱國、襄武縣開國侯、賜紫金魚袋權德輿可守禮部尚書、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On bingyin an edict made Right Remonstrating Doctor, acting Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director, Pillar of State, Marquis of Xiangwu County, granted gold-purple fish bag Quan Deyu acting Rites Minister and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Quan Deyu entered the council as acting Rites Minister.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，翰林學士獨孤郁守本官起居，以妻父權德輿在中書，避嫌也。

translations.literal: On dingmao Hanlin academician Du Gu remained in office as Diary Editor — his wife's father Quan Deyu was in the Secretariat, avoiding suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Du Gu stayed Hanlin but left drafting while his father-in-law served.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊辰朔，以京兆尹許孟容為兵部侍郎，以中丞王播代容，又以呂元膺代播。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month, wuchen new moon: Capital Intendant Xu Mengong was made War Vice Minister; Vice Censor Wang Bo replaced Mengong, and Lü Yuanying replaced Bo.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Xu Mengong, Wang Bo, and Lü Yuanying rotated capital and censor posts.

sentences.zh: 升平大長公主薨。

translations.literal: Princess Shengping the Great Long died.
translations.idiomatic: Princess Shengping died.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宰相裴垍進所撰《德宗實錄》五十卷，賜垍錦彩三百匹、銀器等，史官蔣武、韋處厚等頒賜有差。

translations.literal: On gengchen Chancellor Pei Ji presented the "Veritable Records of Emperor Dezong" in fifty scrolls; Ji was granted three hundred bolts of brocade and silver vessels; historians Jiang Wu, Wei Chuhou, and others received differentiated gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Pei Ji presented fifty scrolls of Dezong's Veritable Records and was richly rewarded.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，定州將楊伯玉誘三軍為亂，拘行軍司馬任迪簡。

translations.literal: On xinsi Dingzhou general Yang Boyu incited the three armies to mutiny and detained acting army commander Ren Dijian.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Yang Boyu mutinied at Dingzhou and seized Ren Dijian.

sentences.zh: 別將張佐元殺伯玉，迪簡謀歸朝，三軍懼，乃殺佐元。

translations.literal: Another general Zhang Zuoyuan killed Boyu; Dijian plotted to submit to court and the three armies feared it — then they killed Zuoyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zuoyuan killed Boyu; the troops then killed Zuoyuan when Dijian sought surrender.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，制以迪簡檢校工部尚書、定州長史，充義武軍節度觀察、北平軍等使。

translations.literal: On renchen an edict made Dijian acting Works Minister, Dingzhou senior administrator, and Yiwu commissioner and observer and Beiping army commander.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Ren Dijian was made Yiwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以前義武軍節度、檢校太尉、兼太子太傅、同平章事張茂昭檢校太尉、兼中書令、河中尹，充河中晉絳慈隰節度使。

translations.literal: On jiawu former Yiwu commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Heir Apparent Grand Tutor, Grand Councilor Zhang Maozhao was made acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, Hedong Intendant, and Hedong Jin- Jiang- Ci- Long commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Zhang Maozhao went to Hedong as director and councilor.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌朔，浙西奏當鎮舊有丹陽軍，今請並為鎮海軍，從之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, wuxu new moon: Zhexi memorialized that the circuit formerly had Danyang army — now requested merger into Zhenhai army — approved.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month: Danyang army merged into Zhenhai.

sentences.zh: 庚子，右金吾衛大將軍伊慎降為右衛將軍，以行賂三十萬與中尉第五從直，求為河東節度故也。

translations.literal: On gengzi Right Golden Guards great general Yi Shen was demoted to Right Guard general — for bribing Commandant Diwu Congzhi with three hundred thousand for the Hedong commission.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Yi Shen fell for bribing Diwu Congzhi for Hedong.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，會王纁薨。

translations.literal: On jiachen Prince of Hui Chong died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Prince Hui Chong died.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以前河中節度使王鍔檢校司空、兼太子太傅、太原尹、北都留守、河東節度使。

translations.literal: On gengxu former Hedong commissioner Wang E was made acting Minister of Works, concurrent Heir Apparent Grand Tutor, Taiyuan Intendant, Northern Capital regent, and Hedong commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Wang E returned to Hedong in high rank.

sentences.zh: 以代州刺史阿跌光進為單于大都護、振武麟勝節度度支營田觀察押蕃落等使。

translations.literal: Dai prefecture A-die Guangjin was made Shanyu Protector-General, Zhenwu Lin-Sheng commissioner, revenue-farming-pacification commissioner, and controller of barbarian tribes.
translations.idiomatic: A-die Guangjin took the northern frontier command.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以中書侍郎、平章事裴垍為兵部尚書。

translations.literal: On gengshen Vice Director and Grand Councilor Pei Ji was made War Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Pei Ji became War Minister.

sentences.zh: 以前保信軍節度使、德州刺史薛昌朝為右武衛將軍。

translations.literal: Former Baoxin commissioner and Dezhou prefect Xue Changchao was made Right Martial Guard general.
translations.idiomatic: Xue Changchao became Right Martial Guard general.

sentences.zh: 前為王承宗虜之，囚於鎮州，至是歸朝故也。

translations.literal: Earlier Chengzong had seized him and imprisoned him at Zhen prefecture — now he returned to court for that reason.
translations.idiomatic: He had been Chengzong's prisoner until now.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，吏部郎中柳公綽獻《太醫箴》，上深喜納，遣中使勞之。

translations.literal: On bingyin Personnel Department bureau director Liu Gongchuo presented "The Grand Physician's Admonition"; the Emperor deeply delighted and accepted it, sending an inner attendant to console him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Liu Gongchuo's medical admonition pleased the throne.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁卯朔。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, dingmao new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth month opened on dingmao.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，諸道鹽鐵轉運使、刑部尚書李鄘檢校吏部尚書，兼揚府長史，充淮南節度使。

translations.literal: On guiyou overall salt-iron transport commissioner and Penal Minister Li Yong was made acting Personnel Minister, concurrent Yangzhou senior administrator, and Huainan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Li Yong took Huainan.

sentences.zh: 以河南尹房式為宣州刺史、宣歙池觀察、採石軍等使。

translations.literal: Henan Intendant Fang Shi was made Xuan prefect, Xuan-She-Chi observer, and Caishi army commander.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Shi took Xuan-She.

sentences.zh: 以前宣歙觀察使盧坦為刑部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運使。

translations.literal: Former Xuan-She observer Lu Tan was made Penal Vice Minister and overall salt-iron transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tan took salt-iron transport.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以吏部郎中柳公綽為御史中丞。

translations.literal: On renwu Personnel bureau director Liu Gongchuo was made Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Liu Gongchuo became Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 以前御史中丞呂元膺為鄂州刺史、鄂黃岳沔蘄安黃等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Former Vice Censor-in-Chief Lü Yuanying was made E prefect and E-Huang-Yue-Mian-Qi-An-Huang observer.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Yuanying took the middle Yangzi command.

sentences.zh: 以鄂岳察使郗士美為河南尹。

translations.literal: E-Yue observer Xi Shimei was made Henan Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Xi Shimei became Henan Intendant.

sentences.zh: 新授諫議大夫蔣武請改名乂。

translations.literal: Newly appointed Remonstrating Doctor Jiang Wu requested renaming himself Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Jiang Wu took the name Yi.

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎崔邠為太常卿。

translations.literal: Personnel Vice Minister Cui Bin was made Court of Imperial Sacrifices Director.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Bin became Court of Sacrifices director.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月丙寅朔。

translations.literal: Sixth year, spring, first month, bingyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: Year 6, spring, first month, bingyin new moon.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以彰義軍留後吳少陽檢校工部尚書，充彰義軍節度、申光蔡等州觀察使。

translations.literal: On bingshen Zhangyi acting commissioner Wu Shaoyang was made acting Works Minister and Zhangyi commissioner and Shen-Guang-Cai observer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Wu Shaoyang was confirmed over Zhangyi.

sentences.zh: 敕諫議大夫孟簡、給事中劉伯芻、工部侍郎歸登、右補闕蕭俯等於豐泉寺翻譯《大乘本生心地觀音經》。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Remonstrating Doctor Meng Jian, Drafting Editor Liu Bozhu, Works Vice Minister Gui Deng, Right Remonstrance Aide Xiao Fu, and others to translate the "Mahayana Root Mind-Ground Kuan-yin Sutra" at Fengquan Temple.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Jian and others were ordered to translate a Buddhist sutra at Fengquan Temple.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以淮南節度使、中書侍郎、同平章事、趙國公李吉甫復知政事、集賢殿大學士、監修國史。

translations.literal: On gengshen Huainan commissioner, Vice Director, Grand Councilor, Duke of Zhao Li Jifu again handled administration, Jixian Hall Grand Academician, and supervised national history.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Li Jifu returned to the council from Huainan.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔。

translations.literal: Second month, bingyin new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The second month opened on bingyin.

sentences.zh: 壬申，門下侍郎、同平章事李籓為太子詹事。

translations.literal: On renshen Vice Director and Grand Councilor Li Fan was made Crown Prince Household Head.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Li Fan left the council for the heir's household.

sentences.zh: 籓與吉甫不葉，吉甫既用事，故罷籓相位。

translations.literal: Fan and Jifu were not in harmony; Jifu once in power, hence Fan's chancellorship was ended.
translations.idiomatic: Jifu had ousted his rival Fan from the council.

sentences.zh: 丙子，河中節度使、檢校太尉、中書令張茂昭卒。

translations.literal: On bingzi Hedong commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat Director Zhang Maozhao died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Zhang Maozhao died at Hedong.

sentences.zh: 乙太府卿裴次元為福建觀察使。

translations.literal: Acting Court of the Imperial Treasury Director Pei Ciyuan was made Fujian observer.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Ciyuan took Fujian.

sentences.zh: 己丑，訴王造薨。

translations.literal: On jichou Prince of Su Zao died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Prince Su Zao died.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以陝虢觀察使張弘靖檢校禮部尚書、河中尹、晉絳慈等州節度使，以右丞衛次公為陝府長史、陝虢觀察使。

translations.literal: On guisi Shaan-Guo observer Zhang Hongjing was made acting Rites Minister, Hedong Intendant, and Jin- Jiang- Ci commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zhang Hongjing went to Hedong;

sentences.zh: 以中書舍人、翰林學士李绛為戶部侍郎。

translations.literal: Right Vice Director Wei Cigong was made Shaanfu senior administrator and Shaan-Guo observer.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Cigong took Shaan-Guo;

sentences.zh: 以京畿民貧，貸常平義倉粟二十四萬石，諸道州府依此賑貸。

translations.literal: Secretariat Drafting Editor and Hanlin academician Li Jiang was made Revenue Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang became Revenue Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未朔，以河南尹郗士美檢校工部尚書，兼潞府長史、昭義軍節度使。

translations.literal: Because the capital region's people were poor, Ever-Normal Granary charity grain of two hundred forty thousand shi was lent; all circuits' prefectures were to relieve and lend by this model.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred forty thousand shi of charity grain were lent around the capital and ordered copied empire-wide.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以檢校右僕射嚴綬為江陵尹荊南節度使。

translations.literal: Third month, yiwei new moon: Henan Intendant Xi Shimei was made acting Works Minister, concurrent Lu senior administrator and Zhaoyi commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: Xi Shimei took Zhaoyi.

sentences.zh: 河東舊使錫錢，民頗為弊，宜於蔚州置五爐鑄錢。

translations.literal: On dingwei acting Right Vice Director Yan Shou was made Jiangling Intendant and Jingnan commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Yan Shou took Jingnan.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，畿內軍鎮牧放，駙馬貴族略獲，並不得帶兵仗，恐雜盜也。

translations.literal: Hedong formerly used tin cash — the people suffered greatly; it was fitting to set five furnaces at Wei prefecture to cast coin.
translations.idiomatic: Hedong's tin money was to be replaced by five mint furnaces at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙丑朔。

translations.literal: On yimao within the metropolitan region army garrisons pastured livestock — imperial sons-in-law and nobles roughly hunted — all may not carry arms, fearing mixed bandits.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao garrison pasturage and noble hunts in the capital were barred from carrying weapons.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，兵部尚書裴垍為太子賓客，以諫議大夫裴堪為同州防禦從事使。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, yichou new moon.
translations.idiomatic: In summer the fourth month opened on yichou.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以戶部侍郎、判度支李夷簡檢校禮部尚書、襄州大都督府長史、山南東道節度使；

translations.literal: On wuchen War Minister Pei Ji was made Crown Prince Guest; Remonstrating Doctor Pei Kan was made Tongzhou defense staff commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Pei Ji left war for the heir's court; Pei Kan went to Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 以刑部侍郎、鹽鐵轉運使盧坦為戶部侍郎、判度支；

translations.literal: On gengwu Revenue Vice Minister and acting revenue commissioner Li Yijian was made acting Rites Minister, Xiangzhou metropolitan senior administrator, and Shannan East commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Li Yijian took Shannan East;

sentences.zh: 京兆尹王播為刑部侍郎，充諸道鹽鐵轉運使；

translations.literal: Penal Vice Minister and salt-iron transport commissioner Lu Tan was made Revenue Vice Minister and acting revenue commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Lu Tan took revenue;

sentences.zh: 以福建觀察使元義方為京兆尹。

translations.literal: Capital Intendant Wang Bo was made Penal Vice Minister and overall salt-iron transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo took salt-iron transport;

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以張茂昭家妓四十七人歸定州。

translations.literal: Fujian observer Yuan Yifang was made Capital Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Yifang became Capital Intendant.

sentences.zh: 己卯，月近房。

translations.literal: On guiyou Zhang Maozhao's household singing girls, forty-seven persons, were returned to Dingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou forty-seven of Zhang Maozhao's entertainers were sent back to Dingzhou.

sentences.zh: 以前荊南節度使趙宗儒為刑部尚書。

translations.literal: On jimao the moon approached Fang.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the moon neared Fang mansion.

sentences.zh: 東都留守鄭余慶為兵部尚書，依前留守。

translations.literal: Former Jingnan commissioner Zhao Zongru was made Penal Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Zongru became Penal Minister.

sentences.zh: 王播奏：江淮河嶺已南、兗鄆等鹽院，元和五年都收賣鹽價錢六百九十八萬五千五百貫。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital regent Zheng Yuqing was made War Minister, continuing as regent.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yuqing became War Minister while staying Luoyang regent.

sentences.zh: 校量未改法已前四倍抬估，虛錢一千七百四十六萬三千七百貫。

translations.literal: Wang Bo memorialized: Jiang-Huai, rivers, passes, and ranges southward and Yan-Yun and other salt offices — Yuanhe 5's total salt-sale receipts were six million nine hundred eighty-five thousand five hundred strings.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bo reported Yuanhe 5 salt receipts at nearly seven million strings.

sentences.zh: 除鹽本外，付度支收管。

translations.literal: Compared with before the law was changed, fourfold inflated estimate — empty money seventeen million four hundred sixty-three thousand seven hundred strings.
translations.idiomatic: Fourfold inflation since the old law had added over seventeen million in paper valuation.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Apart from salt principal, deliver to revenue for custody.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond salt cost, surplus went to revenue.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，戶部奏置巡官。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午朔，取受王承宗錢物人品官王伯恭杖死。

translations.literal: On xinmao Revenue memorialized establishing patrol officers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Revenue established patrol officers.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以左金吾衛將軍李惟簡檢校戶部尚書、鳳翔尹、隴右節度使。

translations.literal: Fifth month, jiawu new moon: Wang Bogong, an official who had taken Wang Chengzong's money, was beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month: Wang Bogong was executed for taking Chengzong's bribes.

sentences.zh: 丙午，前山南東道節度使、檢校左僕射、平章事裴均卒。

translations.literal: On gengzi Left Golden Guards general Li Weijian was made acting Revenue Minister, Fengxiang Intendant, and Longyou commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Li Weijian took Fengxiang and Longyou.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以振武節度阿跌光進夙彰誠節，久立茂勳，宜賜姓李氏。

translations.literal: On bingwu former Shannan East commissioner, acting Left Vice Director, Grand Councilor Pei Jun died.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Pei Jun died.

sentences.zh: 弟洺州刺史光顏，已從別敕處分。

translations.literal: On renzi because Zhenwu commissioner A-die Guangjin long showed loyal integrity and long-standing flourishing merit, the surname Li should be granted.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi A-die Guangjin was granted the surname Li for merit.

sentences.zh: 六月甲子朔，減教坊樂人衣糧。

translations.literal: Younger brother Ming prefect Li Guangyan had already been handled by a separate edict.
translations.idiomatic: His brother Guangyan had already been honored separately.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，中書門下奏：

translations.literal: Sixth month, jiazi new moon: reduce Teaching Bureau musicians' clothing and grain rations.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: Teaching Bureau rations were cut.

sentences.zh: 「官省則事省，事省則人清；

translations.literal: On dingmao Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized:
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized:

sentences.zh: 官煩則事煩，事煩則人濁。

translations.literal: "When offices are few, affairs are few; when affairs are few, men are pure;
translations.idiomatic: "Fewer offices mean purer government;

sentences.zh: 清濁之由，在官之煩省。

translations.literal: when offices are numerous, affairs are numerous; when affairs are numerous, men are turbid.
translations.idiomatic: too many offices mean corrupt government.

sentences.zh: 國家自天寶已後，中原宿兵，見在軍士可使者八十余萬。

translations.literal: The cause of purity and turbidity lies in the numerousness or fewness of offices.
translations.idiomatic: Purity depends on trimming the bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 其餘浮為商販，度為僧道，雜入色役，不歸農桑者，又十有五六。

translations.literal: The state since Tianbao has garrisoned the central plain — present soldiers fit for use number more than eight hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Since Tianbao eight hundred thousand soldiers have been kept on the books;

sentences.zh: 則是天下常以三分勞筋苦骨之人，奉七分坐衣待食之輩。

translations.literal: The rest float as merchants and peddlers, become monks and Daoists, mix into colored corvée, not returning to farming and mulberry — again one or two in ten or five or six.
translations.idiomatic: another fifth or sixth of the realm neither farms nor serves.

sentences.zh: 今內外官給俸料者不下一萬餘員，其間有職出異名，奉離本局，府寺曠廢，簪組因循者甚眾。

translations.literal: Then all under Heaven constantly uses three parts laboring sinew and bone to support seven parts sitting clothed awaiting food.
translations.idiomatic: Three labor for every seven who only consume.

sentences.zh: 況斂財日寡而授祿至我，設官有限而入色無數，九流安得不雜，萬物安得不煩。

translations.literal: Now inner and outer offices receiving salary are not fewer than ten thousand posts; among them are posts with duties under strange names, salaries separate from the original bureau, offices vacant and abandoned, yet ranks drift on — very many.
translations.idiomatic: Over ten thousand salaried posts include phantom titles and empty desks.

sentences.zh: 漢初置郡不過六十，文景醲化，百官莫先，則官少不必政紊，郡多不必事理。

translations.literal: Moreover revenue daily grows scant while bestowed salaries reach us — offices limited yet entrants to the colored ranks unlimited; how can the nine streams not be mixed, how can the myriad things not be troubled.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue shrinks while salaries swell and sinecures multiply without limit.

sentences.zh: 今天下三百郡，一千四百縣。

translations.literal: Early Han established not more than sixty commanderies; Wen and Jing's thick transformation — the hundred offices had none before them — then few offices need not mean confused government, many commanderies need not mean confused affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Han had only sixty commanderies yet flourished — few offices need not mean chaos.

sentences.zh: 故有一邑之地，虛設群司，一鄉之甿，徒分縣職，所費至廣，所制全輕。

translations.literal: Today all under Heaven has three hundred commanderies, one thousand four hundred counties.
translations.idiomatic: Today there are three hundred commanderies and fourteen hundred counties.

sentences.zh: 伏請敕吏兵部侍郎、郎中、給事中、中書舍人各一人，錯綜利病，詳定廢置，吏員可並省者並省之，州縣可併合者併合之，每年入仕者可停減者停減之。

translations.literal: Hence one town's territory vainly sets many offices; one township's farmers vainly divide county duties — expense reaches vast extent, control entirely light.
translations.idiomatic: One town hosts many offices; one township splits county duties — vast cost, light control.

sentences.zh: 此則利廣而易求，官少而易理，稍減冗食，足寬疲甿。

translations.literal: We humbly request an edict to Personnel and War vice ministers, bureau directors, gentlemen, and drafting editors, one each, to weave together benefit and harm, detail abolition and retention — staff posts that can be merged, merge them; prefectures and counties that can be merged, merge them; annual entrants that can be reduced, reduce them.
translations.idiomatic: They asked a commission to merge offices, counties, and annual entrants.

sentences.zh: 又國家舊章，依品制俸，官一品月俸三十千，其餘職田祿米，大約不過千石，自一品以下，多少可知。

translations.literal: Then benefit will be broad and easy to seek, offices few and easy to govern, slightly reducing redundant eaters, enough to ease the weary farmers.
translations.idiomatic: Trimming eaters would ease the farmers' burden.

sentences.zh: 艱難已來，禁綱漸弛，於是增置使額，厚請俸錢。

translations.literal: Moreover the state's old regulations, according to rank fixing salary — first rank monthly salary thirty thousand, the rest field, salary grain, and rice, altogether not exceeding one thousand shi — from first rank down, more or less knowable.
translations.idiomatic: Old salary tables capped even first rank at modest levels.

sentences.zh: 故大曆中權臣月俸有至九千貫者，列郡刺史無大小給皆千貫。

translations.literal: Since hardship, prohibitions gradually slackened — then added commissioner quotas, thickly requested salary cash.
translations.idiomatic: Since the rebellion extra commissioners had claimed swollen cash salaries.

sentences.zh: 常袞為相，始立限約，至李泌又量其閑劇，隨事增加，時謂通濟，理難減削。

translations.literal: Thus in Dali reign powerful ministers' monthly salary reached nine thousand strings; every circuit prefect regardless of size all received one thousand strings.
translations.idiomatic: Dali ministers had drawn nine thousand strings monthly; every prefect one thousand.

sentences.zh: 然猶有名存職廢，額去俸存，閑劇之間，厚薄頓異。

translations.literal: When Chang Gun was chancellor he first set limits; when Li Mi again measured idle and urgent, increasing with the matter — at the time called "general relief," hard to reduce.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Gun and Li Mi had tried to cap pay — called relief, yet hard to cut.

sentences.zh: 將為永式，須立常規。

translations.literal: Yet still there are names surviving while duties are abolished, quotas gone while salary remains — between idle and urgent, thick and thin suddenly differ.
translations.idiomatic: Titles lingered after duties vanished; pay varied wildly between posts.

translations.literal: To make an eternal model, a constant regulation must be established."
translations.idiomatic: A permanent salary law was needed.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: The reform memorial was approved.

sentences.zh: 乃命給事中段平仲、中書舍人韋貫之、兵部侍郎許孟容、戶部侍郎李絳等詳定減省。

translations.literal: Then Drafting Editor Duan Pingzhong, Secretariat Drafting Editor Wei Guanzhi, War Vice Minister Xu Mengong, Revenue Vice Minister Li Jiang, and others were ordered to detail reduction.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Pingzhong, Wei Guanzhi, Xu Mengong, and Li Jiang were ordered to draft cuts.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以御史中丞柳公綽為湖南觀察使。

translations.literal: On jiashen Vice Censor-in-Chief Liu Gongchuo was made Hunan observer.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Liu Gongchuo took Hunan.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白近右執法。

translations.literal: On dinghai Great White approached Right Law Enforcement.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Venus neared Right Law Enforcement.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜御史中丞竇易直緋魚袋。

translations.literal: On wuzi Vice Censor-in-Chief Dou Yizhi was granted crimson fish bag.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Dou Yizhi received a crimson fish bag.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸巳朔，尚書右僕射致仕高郢卒。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, guisi new moon: retired Right Vice Director Gao Ying died.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, guisi new moon: retired Gao Ying died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，贈銀青光祿大夫、太子賓客裴垍太子少傅。

translations.literal: On gengshen posthumous Silver-Green Glory Grandee, Crown Prince Guest Pei Ji was posthumously made Heir Apparent Junior Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Pei Ji was posthumously made Junior Tutor.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥朔，戶部侍郎李絳奏：「諸州闕官職田祿米，及見任官抽一分職田，請所在收貯，以備水旱賑貸。

translations.literal: Eighth month, jiahai new moon: Revenue Vice Minister Li Jiang memorialized: "Prefectures lacking officials' field, salary grain, and rice, and incumbent officials' one-tenth field deduction — request local storage, to prepare flood and drought relief lending."
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month: Li Jiang asked to pool officials' field grain for famine relief.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiang's proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以天德軍防禦使張煦為夏州刺史、夏綏銀等州節度使。

translations.literal: On yichou Tiande army defense commissioner Zhang Xu was made Xia prefect and Xia-Sui-Yin commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhang Xu took Xia-Sui-Yin.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，荊南先置永安軍，宜停。

translations.literal: On dingmao Jingnan's former Yong'an army should cease.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Jingnan's Yong'an army was abolished.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以常州刺史崔芃為洪州刺史、江西觀察使。

translations.literal: On xinsi Changzhou prefect Cui Ping was made Hong prefect and Jiangxi observer.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Cui Ping took Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳朔，以蜀州刺史崔能為黔中觀察使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, guisi new moon: Shu prefect Cui Neng was made Qianzhong observer.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month: Cui Neng took Qianzhong.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，富平縣人梁悅為父復仇，殺秦杲，投獄請罪。

translations.literal: On wuxu Fuping commoner Liang Yue avenged his father, killed Qin Gao, entered prison and requested punishment.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Liang Yue killed his father's murderer and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 特敕免死，決杖一百，配流循州。

translations.literal: A special edict exempted death, ordered one hundred blows of the staff, and exile to Xun prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was spared death, caned, and exiled to Xunzhou.

sentences.zh: 職方員外郎韓愈獻議執奏之。

translations.literal: Duty Section outer-office gentleman Han Yu presented a memorial arguing and impeaching.
translations.idiomatic: Han Yu memorialized against the leniency.

sentences.zh: 減諸司流外總一千七百六十九人。

translations.literal: Reduced outer-service personnel of all offices by one thousand seven hundred sixty-nine in all.
translations.idiomatic: Outer-service staff were cut by 1,769.

sentences.zh: 貶黔中觀察使竇群為開州刺史，以為政煩苛，辰、錦二州蠻叛故也。

translations.literal: Qianzhong observer Dou Qun was demoted to Kai prefect — for harsh government; Chen and Jin two prefectures' barbarians rebelled for that reason.
translations.idiomatic: Dou Qun was demoted for harsh rule that sparked Chen and Jin rebellions.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，以前夏州節度使李願檢校兵部尚書、徐州刺史，充武甯軍節度使。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: former Xia commissioner Li Yuan was made acting War Minister, Xuzhou prefect, and Wuning commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month: Li Yuan took Wuning at Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以戶部尚書韓皋為東都留守，判東都尚書省事。

translations.literal: On wuchen Revenue Minister Han Gao was made Eastern Capital regent and acting Eastern Capital Secretariat director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Han Gao became Luoyang regent.

sentences.zh: 以太子詹事李籓為華州刺史、潼關防禦、鎮國軍使。

translations.literal: Crown Prince Household Head Li Fan was made Hua prefect, Tong Pass defense commissioner, and Zhenguo army commander.
translations.idiomatic: Li Fan took Hua and Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 以東都留守鄭余慶為吏部尚書。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital regent Zheng Yuqing was made Personnel Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Zheng Yuqing became Personnel Minister.

sentences.zh: 己巳，詔：「朕于百執事、群有司，方澄源流，以責實效。

translations.literal: On jisi an edict: "We toward the hundred executors and the host of offices are clarifying the source stream to demand real effect.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi an edict began streamlining administration:

sentences.zh: 轉運重務，專委使臣，每道有院，分督其任；

translations.literal: Transport is a weighty affair, specially entrusted to envoys — each circuit has an office dividing supervision;
translations.idiomatic: transport offices duplicated commissioners;

sentences.zh: 今陝路漕引悉歸中都，而尹守職名尚仍舊貫。

translations.literal: now Shaan route's grain towing all returns to the center, yet the Intendant's duty title still keeps the old name.
translations.idiomatic: Shaan grain now went to the capital yet old titles remained.

sentences.zh: 又諸道都團練使，足修武備以靖一方；

translations.literal: Moreover each circuit's overall training commissioners suffice to repair military readiness and pacify one region;
translations.idiomatic: Training commissioners should have sufficed for defense;

sentences.zh: 而別置軍額，因加吏祿，亦既虛設，頗為浮費。

translations.literal: yet separately establishing army quotas, thereby adding official salaries, is also empty establishment, quite floating expense.
translations.idiomatic: extra army quotas only added salaries.

sentences.zh: 思去煩以循本，期省事以使人。

translations.literal: Thinking to remove trouble and return to root, expecting to economize affairs and employ men.
translations.idiomatic: The throne sought to cut redundancy.

sentences.zh: 其河水陸運、陝府陸運、潤州鎮海軍、宣州採石軍、越州義勝軍、洪州南昌軍、福州靖海軍等使額，並宜停。

translations.literal: River water-and-land transport, Shaanfu land transport, Runzhou Zhenhai army, Xuanzhou Caishi army, Yuezhou Yisheng army, Hongzhou Nanchang army, Fuzhou Jinghai army commissioner quotas are all to cease.
translations.idiomatic: Numerous transport and army commissioner posts were abolished.

sentences.zh: 所收使已下俸料一事已來，委本道充代百姓闕額兩稅，仍具數奏聞。

translations.literal: Commissioner-and-below salaries collected since the affair began are entrusted to each circuit to cover the people's missing two-tax quota, still memorializing the amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Saved salaries were to offset local two-tax shortfalls.

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，詔：「王者之牧黎元也，愛之如子，視之如傷。

translations.literal: On wuyin an edict: "A king's tending the black-haired masses loves them as children, views them as wounded.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin a famine edict opened:

sentences.zh: 苟或風雨不時，稼穡不稔，則必除煩就簡，惜力重勞，以圖便安，以阜生業。

translations.literal: If wind and rain are not timely, crops are not abundant, then surely remove trouble and adopt simplicity, spare strength and value toil, to seek convenience and peace, to enrich livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: When harvests fail, the ruler must lighten burdens.

sentences.zh: 況邦畿之內，百役所業，雖勤恤之令亟行，而供億之制猶廣。

translations.literal: Moreover within the metropolitan region, the hundred corvées labor — though diligent relief orders are urgently issued, the supply burden is still broad.
translations.idiomatic: The capital's corvée and supply burden remained heavy.

sentences.zh: 重以經夏炎暵，自秋霖澤，南畝虧播植之功，西成失豐登之望。

translations.literal: Added to summer's heat and drought, since autumn continuous rain — southern fields lost sowing's work, western harvest lost abundant hope.
translations.idiomatic: Summer drought and autumn floods had ruined both plantings and harvest.

sentences.zh: 內管口食，外牽王徭，豈惟轉輸之虞，慮有餒殍之患。

translations.literal: Inner managed mouth-food, outer drawn royal corvée — not only transport's worry, fear there is starvation's affliction.
translations.idiomatic: Tax grain and corvée threatened starvation.

sentences.zh: 斯蓋理道猶鬱，和氣未通，永言於茲，良所咎歎。

translations.literal: This is because the Way is still obstructed, harmonious qi not yet penetrating — speaking of it here, truly what we blame and sigh.
translations.idiomatic: He blamed cosmic disorder and his own governance.

sentences.zh: 京兆府每年所配折糶粟二十五萬石宜放。

translations.literal: The capital district's yearly allotted diverted-sale grain of two hundred fifty thousand shi should be remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred fifty thousand shi of diverted grain were remitted.

sentences.zh: 于百姓有粟情願折納者，時估外特加優饒。

translations.literal: For commoners with grain willing to deliver in commutation, beyond market price specially add generous bounty.
translations.idiomatic: Grain commutation was priced generously above market.

sentences.zh: 今春所貸義倉粟，方屬歲饑，容至豐熟歲送納。

translations.literal: This spring's lent charity-granary grain, being famine year, may wait until abundant harvest years to repay.
translations.idiomatic: Spring charity loans could wait for good years to repay.

sentences.zh: 元和五年已前諸色逋租並放。

translations.literal: All arrears of various levies before Yuanhe 5 are remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All tax arrears before Yuanhe 5 were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 百官職田，其數甚廣，今緣水潦，諸處道路不通，宜令所在貯納，度支支用，令百官據數於太倉請受。

translations.literal: The hundred officials' field allotments are very numerous; now because of flood, everywhere roads are blocked — let local storage receive them, revenue disburse, letting the hundred officials draw amounts from the Grand Granary.
translations.idiomatic: Officials' field grain was to be stored locally and drawn from the Grand Granary.

sentences.zh: 遭水旱處，通計所損，便與除破，不得檢覆。

translations.literal: Where flood and drought struck, totaling damage, grant remission at once, no inspection or verification.
translations.idiomatic: Flood districts were to be written off without audit.

sentences.zh: 為理之本，在乎安人。

translations.literal: The root of governance lies in settling the people.
translations.idiomatic: Good government meant settled people.

sentences.zh: 咨爾尹京宰邑之臣，實為親人阜俗之寄，必當詢其疾苦，奉我詔條，恤隱為心，無怠於事，罔或徇利以剝下，吐剛而茹柔，使閭井咸安，惸嫠獲濟。

translations.literal: You capital Intendants and magistrates are truly entrusted as kin to the people and uplifters of custom — you must inquire into their hardship, uphold our edict articles, take compassion as heart, be not slack in affairs, never pursue profit to strip the lowly, spit out the hard and swallow the soft, so that lanes and wells are all at peace and the solitary and weak obtain relief.
translations.idiomatic: Capital magistrates were ordered to inquire into suffering and forbid squeezing the poor.

sentences.zh: 各勉忠孝，宜悉朕懷。

translations.literal: Each strive in loyalty and filial piety — know fully our intent."
translations.idiomatic: He closed urging loyal, humane local rule.

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，以諫議大夫孔戣為皇太子諸王侍讀。

translations.literal: On bingxu Remonstrating Doctor Kong Zhi was made crown prince and princes' lecturer.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Kong Zhi became lecturer to the heir and princes.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬辰朔。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, renchen new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The eleventh month opened on renchen.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，新授華州刺史李籓卒。

translations.literal: On guisi newly appointed Hua prefect Li Fan died.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Li Fan died before reaching Hua.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以工部尚書趙昌檢校兵部尚書，兼華州刺史，充潼關防禦、鎮國軍等使。

translations.literal: On yisi Works Minister Zhao Chang was made acting War Minister, concurrent Hua prefect, Tong Pass defense, and Zhenguo army commander.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Zhao Chang took Hua and Tong Pass.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥朔。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, jiahai new moon.
translations.idiomatic: The twelfth month opened on jiahai.

sentences.zh: 壬申，詔委宗正卿選人門嫁十六宅諸王女，仍封為縣主。

translations.literal: On renshen an edict entrusted the Court of the Imperial Clan director to select men to marry the Sixteen Residences princes' daughters, still enfeoffing them as district princesses.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen clan marriages were arranged for sixteen-residence princesses.

sentences.zh: 甲申，京兆尹元義方、戶部侍郎判度支盧坦以違令立戟，罰一月俸，收奪所請門戟。

translations.literal: On jiashen Capital Intendant Yuan Yifang and Revenue Vice Minister and acting revenue commissioner Lu Tan, for violating the edict erecting halberds, were fined one month's salary and the requested gate halberds confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Yuan Yifang and Lu Tan lost a month's pay over illegal gate halberds.

sentences.zh: 己丑，制以朝義郎、守尚書戶部侍郎、驍騎尉、賜紫金魚袋李絳為朝議大夫、守中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事。

translations.literal: On jichou an edict made Court Discussion Gentleman, acting Revenue Vice Minister, Valiant Cavalry Captain, granted gold-purple fish bag Li Jiang Court Discussion Doctor, acting Vice Director, and Grand Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Jiang entered the council.

sentences.zh: 閏十二月辛卯朔，右衛上將軍伊慎卒。

translations.literal: Intercalary twelfth month, xinmao new moon: Right Guard senior general Yi Shen died.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary twelfth month, xinmao new moon: Yi Shen died.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，皇太子甯薨，諡曰惠昭，廢朝三日。

translations.literal: On xinhai Crown Prince Ning died; posthumous title Huizhao; court mourning abolished three days.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Crown Prince Ning died as Huizhao; mourning three days.

sentences.zh: 國典無太子薨禮，國子司業裴苣精禮學，特賜於西內定儀。

translations.literal: The national code had no ritual for a crown prince's death; Directorate of Education Vice Director Pei Ju was skilled in ritual studies — specially granted to fix rites within the western inner palace.
translations.idiomatic: With no precedent for a dead heir, Pei Ju was ordered to devise rites in the inner palace.
